item.title: Government: "Japan's 22nd Fukushima Contaminated Water Release Begins on the 30th" (정부 “日 후쿠시마 오염수 22차 방류 30일 시작”)
item.description:
Government: "Japan's 22nd Fukushima Contaminated Water Release Begins on the 30th" (정부 “日 후쿠시마 오염수 22차 방류 30일 시작”)

The Office of the Prime Minister announced on the 29th that Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO) will begin the 22nd release of treated radioactive contaminated water generated from the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant accident on the 30th. The government is monitoring the discharge of treated contaminated water that TEPCO started in 2023. (일본 도쿄전력이 오는 30일 후쿠시마 제1원자력발전소 사고 처리 과정에서 생긴 방사능 오염 처리수의 22차 방류를 시작한다고 국무총리실이 29일 밝혔다. 정부는 도쿄전력이 2023년 시작한 오염 처리수 방류를 감시하고 있다.)

Kim Young-soo, First Deputy Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, stated in a written briefing that afternoon, "TEPCO announced its release plan, including the schedule for the 22nd discharge, around 5 p.m. yesterday (the 28th). According to the announcement, the concentration of tritium (a radioactive substance) in the contaminated water is 170,000 becquerels per liter (Bq/L), and they plan to subsequently dilute it with seawater to below 1,500 Bq/L for release." The release will continue for 19 days until the 17th of next month. <<> Jo Jeong-ah, Secretary General of the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission, explained, "TEPCO stated that the sum of the notified concentration ratios (concentration relative to the allowable release standard) for 29 nuclides subject to measurement and evaluation, excluding tritium, is 0.61, which is below the discharge standard, and no significant concentrations were confirmed in the 39 nuclides they analyzed independently." TEPCO, Japan Environmental Analysis Center (JEAC), and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency (JAEA) have each confirmed that the concentrations of all radioactive elements in the treated water fall below the allowable release standards. <<> TEPCO has been storing the radioactive contaminated water generated from processing the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant accident in tanks. After filtering out radioactive substances through the Advanced Liquid Processing System (ALPS), they collect the treated water in batches and release it into the sea. The discharges began on August 24, 2023, and this is the 22nd release. <<> The government has been auditing whether TEPCO is properly measuring the concentration of radioactive elements in the treated contaminated water. Regarding this, Secretary Jo stated, "The government will dispatch experts from the Korea Institute of Nuclear Safety (KINS) to the Fukushima site during the 22nd discharge period. Our experts will visit the IAEA (International Atomic Energy Agency) field office to assess the discharge situation from the IAEA." (김영수 국무조정실 국무1차장은 이날 오후 서면 브리핑을 통해 “도쿄전력이 어제(28일) 17시경 22차 방류 일정 등 방류 계획을 발표했다”며 “발표에 따르면, 오염수의 (방사성 물질인) 삼중수소 농도는 리터(L)당 17만 베크렐(㏃)이며, 향후 (오염 처리수를) 리터당 1500㏃ 미만으로 해수와 희석해 방류할 계획”이라고 밝혔다. 방류는 다음 달 17일까지 19일간 계속된다.)

item.title: People Power Party Holds Meeting with Youth at Olympic Park: "If the Special Counsel Bill for the Elections Commission Fails to Pass, the Collapse of the Lee Jae-myung Regime Will Begin" (국힘, 올공 청년들과 간담회 “선관위 특검법 통과 안되면 李정권 몰락 시작될 것")
item.description:
People Power Party Holds Meeting with Youth at Olympic Park: "If the Special Counsel Bill for the Elections Commission Fails to Pass, the Collapse of the Lee Jae-myung Regime Will Begin" (국힘, 올공 청년들과 간담회 “선관위 특검법 통과 안되면 李정권 몰락 시작될 것")

On the 29th, the People Power Party held a meeting with youth who have been continuing a protest rally at Seoul's Songpa-gu Olympic Park condemning the infringement of voting rights, in connection with the shortage of ballots for the June 3 local elections. (국민의힘은 29일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 서울 송파구 올림픽공원(올공)에서 참정권 침해 규탄 집회를 이어가고 있는 청년들과 간담회를 열었다.)

Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk attended the "Olympic Park Youth Speak Out" meeting hosted by lawmaker Choi Soo-jin at the National Assembly, stating, "By August 2, it will be 60 days since the June 3 ballot shortage and voting rights infringement incident occurred. Despite this massive incident, the political circles have not even agreed on a special counsel bill as the 60-day mark approaches." He claimed that while the ruling and opposition parties had reached a broad agreement on the method of recommending a special counsel, the scope and targets of the investigation have yet to be finalized. Jang has been arguing that suspicions regarding the Election Commission's servers and computer manipulation should also be included in the special counsel's investigation. <<> Jang said, "Setting aside the special counsel bill, the Democratic Party is pushing to pass a criminal procedure law abolishing supplementary investigative powers at tomorrow's plenary session. If the special counsel bill does not pass tomorrow, it will mark the beginning of the collapse of the Lee Jae-myung regime." <<> Lawmaker Choi Hyung-doo remarked, "Since the Olympic Park polling station was the most contentious site where voting rights were infringed upon, if the youth directly supervise the analysis of ballots from seven electoral districts, it could yield significant results." <<> The meeting was also attended by youth volunteering at Olympic Park, youth continuing the protest rally in Incheon condemning voting rights infringement, and the Fairness and Responsibility Youth Alliance, which has been voicing criticism regarding the voting rights infringement incident. (장동혁 대표는 이날 최수진 의원이 국회에서 주최한 ‘올공 청년들은 말한다’ 간담회에 참석해 “8월 2일이 되면 6·3 투표용지 부족, 참정권 침해 사태가 발생한 지 60일이 된다. 이 엄청난 사태가 발생했는데 정치권은 60일이 다 돼가도록 아직 특검법조차 합의하지 못했다”고 했다. 여야는 앞서 특검 추천 방식 등 큰 틀에선 합의했으나, 수사 대상과 범위 등은 아직 확정되지 않았다는 주장이다. 장 대표는 선관위 서버와 전산 조작 의혹 등도 특검 수사 대상에 포함해야 한다고 주장해왔다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Abolishing Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Powers Passes Judiciary Committee Led by Ruling Party ([속보] ‘檢 보완수사권 폐지’ 형소법 개정안, 與주도로 법사위 통과)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Abolishing Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Powers Passes Judiciary Committee Led by Ruling Party ([속보] ‘檢 보완수사권 폐지’ 형소법 개정안, 與주도로 법사위 통과)

The National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee passed a Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill on the 29th, which includes the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers. The bill was processed under the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, with members of the People Power Party leaving the chamber. (국회 법제사법위원회가 검사의 보완수사권 폐지 등을 골자로 한 형사소송법 개정안을 29일 통과시켰다. 국민의힘 위원들은 퇴장한 가운데 더불어민주당 주도로 처리됐다.)

The Criminal Procedure Act amendment is expected to be submitted to the National Assembly's plenary session on the 30th for processing. (형사소송법 개정안은 오는 30일 국회 본회의에 상정돼 처리될 전망이다.)

item.title: First Lady Kim Attends Korean Film Festival with Brazil's First Lady: "May Our Nations' Friendship Deepen Through Film" (金여사, 브라질 영부인과 韓영화제 참석 “양국 우정, 영화로 더 깊어지길”)
item.description:
First Lady Kim Attends Korean Film Festival with Brazil's First Lady: "May Our Nations' Friendship Deepen Through Film" (金여사, 브라질 영부인과 韓영화제 참석 “양국 우정, 영화로 더 깊어지길”)

<<>> First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, who is accompanying President Lee Jae-myung on a state visit to Brazil, attended a Korean film festival held in São Paulo, Brazil on the 28th (local time). She was joined by Janja Lula da Silva, the wife of the Brazilian President. ()

This year marks the 15th edition of the Brazil Korean Film Festival. In her remarks at the festival, First Lady Kim stated, "The Brazil Korean Film Festival has served as a bridge that allows the people of both countries to understand each other's culture and grow closer through Korean cinema." (이재명 대통령과 함께 브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 김혜경 여사는 28일(현지 시각) 브라질 상파울루에서 열린 한국 영화제에 참석했다. 브라질 대통령의 부인 잔자 룰라 다 시우바 여사도 함께했다.)

"Film is one of the most beautiful arts that transcends language and borders to read the hearts of people," First Lady Kim said. "I hope today's event becomes a meaningful starting point for Korean and Brazilian filmmakers to nurture their dreams together, and I look forward to the friendship between our two countries deepening further through culture and the arts." (브라질 한국 영화제는 올해 15회를 맞았다. 김 여사는 영화제 인사말에서 “브라질 한국 영화제가 한국 영화를 통해 양국 국민이 서로의 문화를 이해하고 더욱 가까워지게 하는 가교 역할을 해왔다”고 했다.)

In her congratulatory speech, First Lady Janja also said, "Today's gathering is not just a cultural exchange but a place of friendship that brings the people of our two nations closer together." She added, "I hope exchanges and cooperation between our countries become more active, and that one day, films created jointly by Korea and Brazil will be screened around the world." (김 여사는 “영화는 언어와 국경을 넘어 사람의 마음을 읽는 가장 아름다운 예술 가운데 하나”라며 “오늘 이 자리가 한국과 브라질 영화인들이 함께 꿈을 키워가는 소중한 출발점이 되기를 바라고, 앞으로도 두 나라 우정이 문화와 예술을 통해 더욱 깊어지기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

First Lady Janja mentioned the film "Parasite" and expressed, "It would be wonderful if there were opportunities for Korea and Brazil to co-produce films and screen them globally." On the occasion of this event, the Korean Academy of Film Arts (KAFA) and the University of São Paulo signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for educational and exchange cooperation in film and video. (잔자 여사도 축사를 통해 “오늘 이 자리는 단순한 문화 교류가 아니라 양국 국민을 더욱 가깝게 이어주는 우정의 자리”라며 “앞으로 양국 교류와 협력이 더욱 활발해져 언젠가는 한국과 브라질이 함께 만든 영화가 세계 곳곳에서 상영되는 날이 오기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

The two First Ladies and attendees watched director Oh Jung-min's film "Coming of Age" that day. Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong of the Presidential Office stated in a written briefing, "This MOU is expected to serve as a foundation for cooperation that strengthens the capabilities of emerging creators from both countries and expands practical cultural exchanges." (잔자 여사는 영화 ‘기생충’을 언급하며 “한국과 브라질이 합작해 영화를 전 세계적으로 상영할 기회가 있으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 이날 행사를 계기로 한국영화아카데미와 상파울루대학은 영화와 영상의 교육 및 교류 협력을 위한 양해각서(MOU)를 체결했다.)

On the 27th, First Lady Kim attended a reception event combined with a cultural program hosted by Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and his wife at the Itamaraty Palace. Alongside First Lady Janja, she also visited the "Festival of Light: Popular Festivals and Brazilian Art" exhibition held at the Cultural Center of the Federal Court of Accounts in Brasília. (두 여사와 참석자들은 이날 오정민 감독의 영화 ‘성인식’을 관람했다. 안귀령 청와대 부대변인은 서면 브리핑을 통해 “이번 업무 협약은 양국 신진 창작자들의 역량을 강화하고 실질적인 문화 교류를 확대하는 협력 기반이 될 것으로 기대된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon's Supplementary Investigation Debate: Not a Single Invited Ruling Party Member Attended (한동훈 보완수사권 토론회, 친전 받은 與 한 명도 안왔다)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon's Supplementary Investigation Debate: Not a Single Invited Ruling Party Member Attended (한동훈 보완수사권 토론회, 친전 받은 與 한 명도 안왔다)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated on the 29th regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's push to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority, saying, "If this law passes, crimes will be put to sleep, leaving only the grievances of victims." <<> That afternoon, Rep. Han held an emergency debate at the National Assembly Members' Office Building under the theme "Prohibiting Supplementary Investigations: Will You Ultimately Side with Criminals?" This marks the first time Han personally organized a debate. In attendance were lawmakers from the People Power Party, including Kim Seong-won, Bae Hyun-jin, Ko Dong-jin, Park Jeong-ha, Jin Jong-oh, Seo Beom-soo, Kim Ye-ji, Kim Geon, Jeong Seong-guk, Yoo Yong-won, Ahn Sang-hoon, and Song Seok-jun. Former pro-Yoon faction member Kim Ki-hyun also attended. <<> Rep. Kim Ki-hyun said, "We cannot sit idly by as a system that could produce countless victims unfolds before our eyes," adding, "We cannot tolerate the entire judicial and investigative command system being undermined due to the misconduct of some prosecutors." <<> Pointing to the empty seats marked with nameplates for "Democratic Party of Korea" and "Ministry of Justice," Rep. Han stated, "The Democratic Party lacks even the courage to debate this law and is committing sins against the people. The Ministry of Justice, fully aware of how necessary supplementary investigations are for victims and citizens, ultimately failed to show up at the debate." Earlier, Han had sent personal letters to all Democratic Party lawmakers, urging them to "attend the debate" on the abolition of supplementary investigation powers. However, no one showed up. <<> Han held up a casebook titled "So That Crimes Cannot Sleep and Grievances Do Not Remain," published in December last year, showcasing exemplary supplementary investigations by the prosecution, and remarked, "Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho, who personally oversaw the creation of such a casebook, is now raising his hands in surrender, saying he will run away from this responsibility." (무소속 한동훈 의원은 29일 더불어민주당이 추진하는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 법안과 관련해 “이 법이 통과되면 죄는 잠들게 되고 피해자들의 억울함만 남게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Hospital stuck with 800 million won in unpaid bills for unaffiliated Chinese patient... Anti-Corruption Commission says “The government should support hospitals” (무연고 중국인 치료비 8억 독박 쓴 병원… 권익위 “정부가 병원 지원해야”)
item.description:
Hospital stuck with 800 million won in unpaid bills for unaffiliated Chinese patient... Anti-Corruption Commission says “The government should support hospitals” (무연고 중국인 치료비 8억 독박 쓴 병원… 권익위 “정부가 병원 지원해야”)

The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission has recommended that relevant government agencies devise measures to support hospitals that take on treatment of unaffiliated foreigners but are unable to collect medical expenses. This does not mean that the state or National Health Insurance should pay the treatment costs on their behalf, but rather that the government should establish a system to help hospitals recover costs by repatriating the foreign patients to their home countries. (무연고 외국인의 치료를 떠맡고 치료비도 받지 못하는 병원을 지원하는 방안을 마련하라고 국민권익위원회가 관계 부처에 권고했다. 치료비를 국가나 국민건강보험이 대신 내주라는 것은 아니고, 해당 외국인을 출신국으로 돌려보내고 병원이 치료비를 받아낼 수 있도록 정부가 나서는 체계를 마련하라는 것이다.)

According to the commission on the 29th, a Chinese national, identified as A, entered South Korea on a tourist visa in September 2019 and illegally took a job washing dishes at a restaurant in Ulsan. Just nine days after starting work, A collapsed and was taken to a hospital in an unconscious state. Diagnosed with a cerebral hemorrhage, A was transferred to Donggang Hospital, which could provide the necessary treatment. A never regained consciousness, and in December of that year, Donggang Hospital, anticipating a prolonged treatment period, moved A to Dongcheon Donggang Hospital, a long-term care facility within the same medical foundation. A remained in a coma for six years and four months before passing away on April 25th of this year. (29일 권익위에 따르면, 중국인 A씨는 2019년 9월 관광 비자로 한국에 들어와 울산 한 식당에 불법 취업했다. 설거지 일을 맡은 A씨는 취업 9일 만에 쓰러져 의식 불명 상태로 한 병원으로 옮겨졌고, 뇌출혈 진단을 받고 이를 치료할 수 있는 동강병원으로 옮겨졌다. A씨는 깨어나지 못했고, 치료가 장기화될 것으로 판단한 동강병원 측은 그해 12월 A씨를 같은 의료재단 내 장기 치료 전문 병원인 동천동강병원으로 옮겼다. A씨는 6년 4개월간 의식 불명 상태로 있다가 지난 4월 25일 숨졌다.)

As an illegal resident, A was not enrolled in health insurance, so the National Health Insurance provided no payments to the hospital, and the entire treatment cost fell as non-covered expenses on the patient. A had a daughter in China who was a minor, and both the daughter and A’s older brother refused to pay the medical bills, citing financial hardship, sending only a document renouncing treatment. After A’s death, they sent a waiver of claim for the body. (A씨는 불법 체류자로 건강보험 가입자가 아니었으므로 건강보험이 병원에 급여해주는 돈은 없었고, 치료비 전액이 건강보험 비급여로 환자 본인 부담이었다. 그런데 A씨 직계 가족으로 중국에 딸이 있었으나 미성년이었고, A씨 딸과 친형은 가정 형편이 어렵다며 치료비를 내지 않았다. A씨에 대한 치료를 포기한다는 문서만 보내 왔다. A씨가 숨진 뒤에는 시신 인도 포기서를 보내 왔다.)

The medical expenses incurred by Dongcheon Donggang Hospital for treating A over six years and four months amounted to 855 million won. While about 18 million won was raised through donations in South Korea and China, 837 million won remains unpaid. (동천동강병원이 A씨를 6년 4개월간 치료하면서 발생한 치료비는 8억5500만원에 달했고, 국내와 중국에서 성금이 1800여만원 전달됐으나 여전히 8억3700만원이 미납 상태다.)

The hospital could not initially refuse to admit A. The Medical Service Act mandates that medical institutions cannot reject requests for medical treatment. Nor could they induce A’s death, as A was capable of breathing on their own, and removing the oxygen mask would not cause death. Furthermore, the Act on Life-Sustaining Treatment Decision mandates that even if life-sustaining treatment is discontinued, the supply of nutrients, water, and the simple provision of oxygen must continue. (병원이 처음에 A씨를 받지 않을 수는 없었다. 의료법은 의료기관이 진료 요청을 받으면 이를 거부하지 못하도록 하고 있기 때문이다. A씨의 사망을 유도할 수도 없었다. A씨가 스스로 호흡할 수 있는 상태였기 때문에 산소 마스크를 떼어낸다고 사망하게 되는 것은 아니고, 연명의료결정법은 연명 의료를 중단하는 경우라도 영양분·물 공급과 ‘산소의 단순 공급’은 계속 하도록 규정하고 있기 때문이다.)

While the government runs a “medical support project for foreign workers,” it only covers workers who have legally resided for over 90 days, so A was ineligible. Since the cerebral hemorrhage was not work-related, A could not receive industrial accident medical benefits either. Under the current system, hospitals are compelled to accept any unaffiliated foreign patient without question, and must continue treatment regardless of how high the costs pile up or whether they can be recovered. (정부가 ‘외국인 근로자 의료 지원 사업’을 시행하고 있지만, 정상적인 체류 자격으로 90일 이상 체류한 근로자만을 대상으로 하기 때문에 A씨는 이 사업으로 지원받을 수 없었다. 뇌출혈이 업무로 인해 생긴 것도 아니었기 때문에 산업재해 요양급여를 받을 수도 없었다. 현행 제도상 병원은 무연고 외국인 환자가 오면 이를 무조건 받을 수밖에 없고, 치료비가 아무리 많이 발생하고 이를 받지 못하는 상황이더라도 치료를 계속해야 한다.)

The commission ruled that the state or health insurance could not cover A’s medical expenses. However, noting that cases like A’s, where hospitals are saddled with unaffiliated foreign patients, are recurring, the commission concluded that relevant agencies must devise measures to prevent hospital losses. The commission pointed out, “Even if the hospital attempts to repatriate the patient, it is impossible without active mediation or diplomatic efforts by the South Korean government, and imposing on private hospitals the obligation to treat emergency, severely ill, and long-term foreign patients under the Medical Service Act without providing institutional support for unpaid medical bills and repatriation issues amounts to shifting responsibility.” (권익위는 A씨의 치료비를 국가나 건강보험이 대신 내줄 수는 없다고 판단했다. 권익위는 그러나 A씨의 사례처럼 병원이 무연고 외국인을 떠맡는 일이 거듭 일어나고 있다며, 병원들의 피해를 막기 위해 관계 부처들이 대책을 마련해야 한다고 봤다. 권익위는 “병원 측이 (무연고 외국인 환자의) 본국 송환을 추진하려고 해도 우리나라 정부의 적극적인 중재나 외교적 노력 없이는 해결이 불가하고, (국가가) 의료법 등에 따라 민간 병원에 응급 중증·장기 외국인 환자 진료 의무를 부여하면서 체납 의료비 및 본국 송환 문제 등에 대한 제도적 지원을 하지 않는 것은 책임 전가”라고 지적했다.)

The commission also noted, “There are cases where foreign governments have paid the treatment costs of South Korean nationals hospitalized long-term with unpaid medical bills from their national budgets and then repatriated them.” For example, a South Korean national identified as B, who showed symptoms of schizophrenia in China, was hospitalized in a psychiatric facility by local public security authorities. When B’s family avoided paying the medical costs, the hospitalization became prolonged. Eventually, the Chinese government covered tens of millions of won in medical bills and sent B back to South Korea. (권익위는 “해외 정부는 의료비 체납 상태로 장기 입원 중인 우리나라 국민의 치료비를 해당 국가 예산으로 대납 후 국내로 송환 조치한 사례가 있다”고도 지적했다. 한국 국적 B씨는 중국에서 조현병 증세를 보여 지역 공안국에 의해 정신병원에 입원 조치됐는데, 가족이 B씨 치료비 부담을 기피하면서 장기 입원하게 됐다. 결국 중국 정부가 의료비 수천만원을 대납하고 B씨를 한국으로 돌려보냈다.)

In response to the commission’s recommendation, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that when similar cases arise, it will make diplomatic efforts to resolve the medical cost issue and repatriate the patient. The city of Ulsan also said it would prepare administrative support manuals for each department. (권익위 권고에 대해 외교부는 비슷한 사례가 발생할 경우 치료비 문제 해결과 환자 본국 송환을 위한 외교적 노력을 기울이겠다고 답했다. 울산시도 부서별 행정 지원 매뉴얼을 마련하겠다고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil Attack with "Defeat in Local Elections"...Jeong Cheong-rae Says "Let's Fight One-on-One" (김민석·송영길 “지방선거 패배” 협공...정청래 “싸움은 일대일로”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil Attack with "Defeat in Local Elections"...Jeong Cheong-rae Says "Let's Fight One-on-One" (김민석·송영길 “지방선거 패배” 협공...정청래 “싸움은 일대일로”)

Later this day, at the first TV debate for the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17th national convention party leadership election, candidates Kim Min-seok, Jeong Cheong-rae, and Song Young-gil argued over the results of the June 3rd local elections, the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, and the failed merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party. Candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil appeared to double-team Jeong Cheong-rae, who defended himself by saying, "I wish we could keep the fight one-on-one." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보는 29일 첫 TV토론회에서 6·3 지방선거 결과, 검사 보완수사권 폐지, 조국혁신당 합당 무산 등을 놓고 논박을 벌였다. 김민석·송영길 후보가 정청래 후보를 협공하고, 정 후보가 “싸움은 일대일로 했으면 좋겠다”며 방어하는 모양새였다.)

During the MBC-hosted TV debate, Candidate Song said, "Candidate Jeong claimed the local elections were a victory, but even President Lee Jae-myung apologized to the people, saying 'we lost where we should have won.' There is a stark difference in evaluating the local elections. Was the President's assessment wrong?" Candidate Jeong replied, "If we define the (local election results) as a defeat, it could brand the entire first year of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the party as a failure. I said the Seoul mayoral race was heartbreaking." (이날 MBC 주관으로 열린 TV토론에서 송 후보는 “정 후보는 지방선거를 두고 승리한 선거라고 말했는데, 이재명 대통령도 ‘이겨야 할 곳을 졌다’며 국민께 사과도 했다”면서 “지방선거 평가에 현격한 차이가 있는데 대통령 생각이 틀렸느냐”고 했다. 정 후보는 “(지방선거 결과를) 패배로 규정하는 순간 이재명 정부와 당의 1년이 통째로 패배로 낙인찍힐 수 있다”면서 “서울시장 부분은 제가 마음이 아프다고 했다”고 했다.)

Candidate Kim also said, "Candidate Jeong, during the Busan election, you made a slip of the tongue, and in the Pyeongtaek election, you practically couldn't campaign there because the party's position wasn't clear. Because of these issues, the President apologized, and we couldn't even define it as a success. Will these election management problems be solved just by you becoming party leader again?" Candidate Jeong retorted, "Candidate Kim doesn't know because he's never been party leader." (김 후보도 “정 후보는 부산 선거 때는 말 실수로, 평택 선거는 입장 정리가 안 됐다는 이유로 두 곳을 못 가다시피 했다”면서 “이런 문제 때문에 대통령께서 사과하고 우리가 성공이라고 규정도 못 했지 않느냐. 이런 선거 지휘 문제가 다시 당대표 하신다고 해결되겠느냐”고 했다. 정 후보는 “김 후보가 당대표를 안 해봐서 모른다”고 맞받았다.)

Candidates Kim and Jeong also engaged in a war of truth over the issue of abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers. Candidate Kim said, "I suggested in May that we quickly finalize and handle the government's position, but wasn't it the party that delayed it?" In response, Candidate Jeong countered, "You say you made a request to the party, but shouldn't you have requested it from the party leader or the floor leader? Why did you bypass those two?" Candidate Kim reiterated, "I have never bypassed the party leader," adding, "I conveyed it through the chair of the Policy Committee, who was the discussion point at the time, and I naturally assumed it would be reported to the party leader." (김 후보와 정 후보는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 문제와 관련해 진실 공방도 벌였다. 김 후보는 “제가 5월에 정부 입장을 빨리 정리해 처리하자고 했는데 당에서 지연시킨 것 아니냐”고 했다. 그러자 정 후보는 “당에게 요청했다는데 당대표나 원내대표한테 요청해야 하는 것 아니냐. 왜 두 사람을 패싱했느냐”고 맞받았다. 김 후보는 재차 “한 번도 당대표를 패싱한 적 없다”면서 “당시 논의선이었던 정책위의장을 통해 (전달했고) 당연히 당대표에게 보고되는 것으로 듣고 있었다”고 했다.)

This time, Candidate Jeong brought up the fact that the Prosecution Reform Promotion Unit under the Prime Minister's Office, despite being allocated a budget of 1.7 billion won, failed to submit a government proposal to the National Assembly, counterattacking by saying, "If a law school professor was given a 1.7 billion won research contract but didn't produce results, they should repay that 1.7 billion won." In response, Candidate Kim said, "Of that 1.7 billion won, only 500 million won was actually spent," adding, "Everyone knows that the discussion on abolishing supplementary investigative powers proceeded by sending the (discussion results) to the National Assembly without submitting a formal bill." (이번에는 정 후보가 국무총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단이 17억원의 예산을 배정받고도 정부안을 국회에 제출하지 않은 것을 거론하며 “로스쿨 교수에게 17억원 주고 연구용역을 맡겼는데 결과물을 내지 않았다면 17억원을 토해내야 한다”고 역공했다. 그러자 김 후보는 “17억원 중 실제로 쓰인 건 5억원”이라면서 “보완수사권 폐지 관련 논의는 법안을 내지 않고 국회에 (논의 결과를) 보내는 방식으로 하는 것은 다 알고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the shared strategy of distributing votes by birthday among pro-Jeong supreme council candidates, Candidate Kim said, "This is blatant old-school politics, the likes of which I haven't seen in the party for over ten years," and added, "Faction-based campaigning is defined as illegal." Candidate Jeong replied, "Candidate Kim has been outside the party for 18 years, so he seems unware of the history during the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in presidencies. This is something party members have always done voluntarily." He then countered, "Aren't Candidate Kim and many other candidates flocking to the race too?" (김 후보는 친청(친정청래)계 최고위원 후보들에 대한 생일별 분산투표 전략이 공유되고 있는 데 대해 “10여 년 동안 당에서 본 적이 없는 노골적인 구태정치”라면서 “계파적 선거운동은 불법으로 규정돼 있다”고 했다. 정 후보는 “김 후보는 당 밖에 18년 동안 있어서 노무현·문재인 대통령이 있을 때의 역사를 잘 모르는 것 같다”면서 “당원들이 늘 자발적으로 해왔던 일”이라고 했다. 이어 “김 후보랑 더 많은 후보들이 몰려들고 있지 않느냐”고 맞받았다.)

Candidate Song said to Candidate Jeong, "Weren't you leading the opposition to the Korea-US FTA during the Roh Moo-hyun administration? At that time, I supported the Korea-US FTA, and at a general meeting of lawmakers, you called for my expulsion for violating the party line. Do you still think that was the right thing to do?" Candidate Jeong said, "Honestly, I don't clearly remember why I called for Candidate Song's expulsion. If I did, I'm sorry." (송 후보는 정 후보를 향해 “노무현 정부 시절 한미 FTA를 앞장서서 반대하지 않았느냐”면서 “당시 제가 한미 FTA에 찬성했더니 의원 총회에서 정 후보가 저를 향해 ‘당론을 어겼다’며 제명하자고 하지 않았느냐. 그 생각이 지금도 옳다고 생각하느냐”고 했다. 정 후보는 “왜 송 후보를 제명하자고 했는지는 제가 솔직히 기억이 잘 안 난다. 그랬다면 미안하게 생각한다”고 했다.)

At today's debate, Candidates Kim, Jeong, and Song each stated their aspirations to become a 'stable governing partner', 'strongly reformist party leader', and 'party leader focused on people's livelihoods', respectively. The Democratic Party's TV debates for the party leadership election will be held on KBS on the 5th of next month and on SBS on the 12th. (이날 토론회에서 김·정·송 후보는 각각 ‘안정적 국정 파트너’, ‘강력한 개혁 당대표’, ‘민생을 챙기는 당대표’가 되겠다고 밝혔다. 민주당 당대표 선거 TV 토론은 다음 달 5일 KBS, 12일 SBS에서 열린다.)

item.title: Frontline K4 Grenade Launcher Also ‘Unloaded for Guard Duty’ (최전방 K4 유탄기관총도 ‘빈총 경계’)
item.description:
Frontline K4 Grenade Launcher Also ‘Unloaded for Guard Duty’ (최전방 K4 유탄기관총도 ‘빈총 경계’)

It was confirmed on the 29th that the Army’s 1st Corps, which plays a key role in defending the western front, has issued a directive not to load live ammunition into the K4 high-speed grenade launcher during guard duty at forward Guard Posts (GP) and General Outposts (GOP). The K4 high-speed grenade launcher has the greatest firepower among the weapons used by infantry in the front-line area and is considered an essential weapon for suppressing the enemy in contingencies. The 1st Corps has already been conducting guard duty without loading belts with live ammunition for the K6 heavy machine gun, a core crew-served weapon on our military’s front line [See this newspaper’s July 29, 2026 edition, Page A1]. <<> According to this newspaper’s investigation, the 1st Corps changed the guard duty guidelines during the first half of this year at the discretion of its corps commander, stipulating that no live ammunition be loaded into the K6 and K4. While the 1st Corps has not disclosed the specific reasons for the guideline change, it is known that the aim was to prevent accidental discharges towards the North. <<> The K4 high-speed grenade launcher is a weapon capable of firing 40mm grenades, with destructive power equivalent to hand grenades, at a rate of six rounds per second. This effectively allows for the automatic firing of grenades like a machine gun, and its destructive power surpasses that of the K6 heavy machine gun. It is generally known that at GOPs, each outpost is typically equipped with one K6 and one K4, paired together. However, if live ammunition is not loaded, the ability to respond immediately in a contingency inevitably decreases. <<> Regarding the 1st Corps’ guideline change, some interpretations within the military suggest that a widespread ‘avoid any trouble at all costs’ complacency has led to the cessation of ammunition loading. Some general officers reportedly believe that if an accident occurs during aggressive operations, their promotion becomes difficult, so they focus solely on accident prevention. A military official said, “There are generals so worried about accidental discharges that they would, proverbially speaking, ‘refuse to make soybean paste for fear of maggots’—meaning they avoid loading crew-served weapons.” <<> Another official stated, “If North Korea crosses the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) and moves south, we implement a DMZ operation to later deploy our troops to verify the MDL markers. However, I am aware that last year, some division commanders were reluctant to conduct these operations due to concerns over safety incidents like landmines.” From 2024 to last year, North Korean troops crossed the MDL multiple times while conducting border fortification work, including laying mines around the MDL area. Yet, it is said that “among the current front-line corps commanders, there is a ‘safety-first’ type general who, when ordered by higher command to conduct a DMZ operation, would turn off his secure mobile phone and delay executing the operation.” There are also concerns that, in the aftermath of the December 3 martial law declaration, the military’s principle of ‘orders from above are unquestioningly obeyed’ has weakened, potentially exacerbating this self-protective mentality. <<> A Joint Chiefs of Staff official said on this day, “Currently, the principle for our military’s operation of firearms in forward areas such as GP and GOP is to have live ammunition loaded.” He added, “Regarding the exceptional operation in some units, we plan to conduct on-site verification and take necessary measures.” This implies that when a corps commander changes guard duty guidelines at their discretion, there must be changes in operational conditions, such as environmental changes. The military will investigate whether there was a valid reason for the cessation of ammunition loading and take action accordingly. (서부전선 방어에 핵심 역할을 하는 육군 1군단이 전방 감시초소(GP)와 일반전초(GOP)에 경계 근무 시 K4 고속유탄기관총에도 실탄을 삽탄(揷彈)하지 말라는 지침을 내린 것으로 29일 확인됐다. K4 고속유탄기관총은 최전방 지역 보병들이 쓰는 화기 중 최대 위력을 가져, 유사시 적 제압을 위해 필수적인 무기로 평가된다. 1군단은 우리 군의 최전방 핵심 공용화기인 K6 중(重)기관총에도 실탄이 든 탄띠를 장전하지 않고 경계 근무를 해왔다<본지 2026년 7월 29일자 A1면>.)

item.title: China's Wang Yi to Visit South Korea on August 19-20, Likely to Discuss North Korea Nuclear and Taiwan Issues (中 왕이, 8월 19~20일 방한 예정… 북핵·대만 문제 논의할 듯)
item.description:
China's Wang Yi to Visit South Korea on August 19-20, Likely to Discuss North Korea Nuclear and Taiwan Issues (中 왕이, 8월 19~20일 방한 예정… 북핵·대만 문제 논의할 듯)

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi is expected to visit South Korea from August 19 for a two-day trip, with the two countries reportedly in final coordination on the schedule. Minister Wang will hold talks with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, likely discussing bilateral issues, as well as North Korea-related and regional and global matters. This would mark Wang Yi's first visit to South Korea for a bilateral foreign ministers' meeting since September 2021, after about five years. (왕이 중국 외교부장(장관)이 다음 달 19일부터 1박 2일 일정으로 방한하는 방안을 한중 양국이 최종 조율 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 왕 부장은 조현 외교부 장관과 회담을 갖고 양국 현안과 북한 및 역내·세계 문제를 논의할 것으로 보인다. 왕 부장이 한중 외교장관 회담을 위해 방한하는 것은 2021년 9월 이후 약 5년 만이다.)

According to a diplomatic source on the 29th, the upcoming talks are expected to cover a wide range of key issues, including follow-up measures from the South Korea-China summit in January and the situation on the Korean Peninsula. Attention is particularly focused on how North Korea's denuclearization will be addressed. Wang Yi's visit to South Korea was previously pushed for the first quarter of this year but did not materialize, and Wang visited North Korea in April. Chinese President Xi Jinping also visited North Korea on the 8th of last month and held talks with Chairman Kim Jong-un, but made no mention of "the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula," leading to interpretations that China is essentially tolerating North Korea's nuclear program. (29일 외교 소식통에 따르면, 이번 회담에서는 지난 1월 한중 정상회담의 후속 조치와 한반도 정세 등 주요 현안이 폭넓게 논의될 전망이다. 특히 북한의 비핵화 문제가 어떻게 다뤄질지 주목된다. 왕 부장 방한은 올 1분기에도 추진됐지만 성사되지 않았고, 왕 부장은 지난 4월 북한을 방문했다. 시진핑 주석도 지난달 8일 북한을 방문해 김정은 국무위원장과 회담했는데 ‘한반도 비핵화’에 대한 언급이 없어, 중국이 사실상 북핵을 용인하는 것이란 해석이 나왔다.)

In response, the South Korean government is said to have conveyed to China its position, through channels including the director-general-level consultations between the two foreign ministries, that it is undesirable for the narrative of China "turning a blind eye to North Korea's nuclear ambitions" to continue spreading, as it does not contribute to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. In this meeting, Minister Cho is expected to reiterate the stance that China should play a more constructive role in the denuclearization and peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula. (이에 우리 정부는 한중 외교부 국장급 협의 등을 계기로 중국의 ‘북핵 묵인설’이 계속 확산하는 것은 바람직하지 않고, 한반도 평화·안정에도 도움이 되지 않는다는 입장을 전한 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 회담에서도 조 장관은 중국이 한반도 비핵화와 평화·안정을 위해 보다 건설적인 역할을 해달라는 입장을 전달할 것으로 보인다.)

Minister Wang, who has emphasized the "One China" principle, is expected to raise the Taiwan issue. Other topics likely to be addressed in the talks include China's installation of structures within the Provisional Measures Zone (PMZ) in the West Sea, the demarcation of the maritime boundary between South Korea and China, and illegal fishing by Chinese fishing vessels. After President Yoon Suk Yeol's state visit to China in January, China moved one of its three large steel structures outside the PMZ, but the remaining two are still located within the zone. Additionally, follow-up discussions on the panda donation requested by President Yoon from President Xi during his China visit are expected to continue. (‘하나의 중국’ 원칙을 강조해 온 왕 부장은 대만 문제를 제기할 것으로 예상된다. 중국의 서해 잠정조치수역(PMZ) 내 구조물 설치 문제, 한·중 해상 경계 획정, 중국 어선의 불법 조업 등의 현안도 이번 회담에서 다뤄질 전망이다. 중국 측은 지난 1월 이재명 대통령의 국빈 방중 이후 대형 철제 구조물 3기 중 1기를 PMZ 밖으로 이동시켰지만, 나머지 2기는 여전히 PMZ 내에 두고 있다. 그 밖에 이 대통령이 방중 시 시 주석에게 요청한 판다 기증 관련 후속 협의도 이번에 이어질 것으로 보인다.)

Minister Wang may also pay a courtesy call on President Yoon during his visit to South Korea. He is expected to request President Yoon's attendance and cooperation at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit to be held in Shenzhen, China, in November this year. Wang Yi is also reportedly coordinating a separate meeting with Unification Minister Kim Yung-ho. (왕 부장이 방한 기간 이 대통령을 예방할 가능성도 있다. 중국이 올 11월 선전(深圳)에서 개최하는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에 이 대통령의 참석과 협조를 당부할 것으로 예상된다. 왕 부장은 정동영 통일부 장관과의 별도 면담도 조율 중인 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Presidential Office: "Re-election of sitting president constitutionally impossible" Opposition: "Lee must declare there will be no re-election" (靑 “현직 대통령 연임, 헌법상 불가능” 野 “李가 직접 연임 없다고 선언해야”)
item.description:
Presidential Office: "Re-election of sitting president constitutionally impossible" Opposition: "Lee must declare there will be no re-election" (靑 “현직 대통령 연임, 헌법상 불가능” 野 “李가 직접 연임 없다고 선언해야”)

As controversy grew over National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik’s remark that “a constitutional amendment for a sitting president’s re-election is a matter of the people’s choice,” the ruling camp moved to contain the fallout. The presidential office conveyed that “President Lee Jae-myung also said a re-election constitutional amendment is impossible,” and all three candidates for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea also unanimously stated that “it’s hard to gain public consent.” However, the opposition continued its offensive, asking, “Why can’t the president directly say the five words: ‘there will be no re-election’?” <<> Speaker Woo posted on Facebook around 11 p.m. on the 28th, saying, “My remarks at the press conference were meant to clarify the basic procedure that a constitutional amendment requires consensus among political actors and the choice of the people to be achieved,” adding, “I regret causing misunderstanding and controversy contrary to my intention.” Earlier that morning, at his first press conference since taking office, he was asked whether the opposition views the goal of constitutional revision as enabling re-election, and replied, “The re-election issue is ultimately a matter of public opinion and the choice of the sovereign, the people.” Half a day later, as the fallout grew, he issued a clarifying statement. <<> Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik told reporters on the 29th regarding Speaker Woo’s remarks: “President Lee stated during his presidential campaign that the constitutional system does not permit it, the public would not easily tolerate it, and it is realistically impossible.” He added, “If I may add my personal view, I believe Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution should remain unshaken.” Article 128, Paragraph 2 stipulates that “a constitutional amendment to extend a president’s term or allow re-election shall not take effect for the president in office at the time the amendment is proposed.” Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo also appeared on MBC Radio, stating, “The president is fully aware that a re-election constitutional amendment is not possible and has repeatedly stated this,” and added, “Some are claiming, like a conspiracy theory, that Speaker Woo coordinated with the Blue House, but that never happened.” <<> Candidates for the Democratic Party’s leadership also distanced themselves. Candidate Kim Min-seok posted on X (formerly Twitter), calling it “constitutionally unrealistic,” and said, “It is neither right nor necessary to further inflate an unexpected issue.” Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae said on CBS Radio, “Speaker Woo seems to have been caught off guard by reporters. His details seem a bit lacking.” Candidate Song Young-gil also stated, “I regret that Speaker Woo created room for misunderstanding.” <<> However, some suggested that Speaker Woo’s remarks on re-election constitutional amendments—given his reputation as a “hardcore pro-Lee” figure—could become a disadvantage for pro-Lee candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil. Candidate Kim Min-seok had said in December last year while serving as Prime Minister, “Five years is too short,” and at a meeting with North Chungcheong Governor Shin Yong-han on the 27th, he asked, “Currently, the president is legally barred from re-election, but you can run again, right?” <<> A key Democratic Party official said, “Yoo Si-min had been facing backlash for his harsh critiques of the president, calling him ‘rotten’ and a ‘sure loser,’ but among the pro-Moon and pro-Roh old mainstream supporters, comments are emerging like, ‘Yoo’s words, which indirectly expressed concerns about indictment cancellation and re-election, turned out to be right.’” Yoo had said in a YouTube broadcast in May that “President Lee’s re-election is constitutionally impossible.” On the same day, Senior Secretary Hong Ik-pyo responded to the so-called “backroom deal for indictment cancellation theory” by stating, “There is no reason to make a backroom deal with the prosecution, nor any intention to do so.” <<> The People Power Party escalated its criticism, demanding, “The president must state his position directly.” President Lee, who is on a diplomatic tour of South America, had not personally stated his position as of that day. This contrasted with his usual behavior of holding senior aide meetings online and posting on X while traveling. <<> People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, “If (President Lee) clearly declares the five words ‘there will be no re-election’ before the public, all controversy will end in an instant,” adding, “If (Lee) attempts to cancel trials and push for a re-election constitutional amendment, that day will be the last for the Democratic Party and this administration.” Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon remarked, “The National Assembly Speaker, a ‘Lee-pick’ from former President Lee’s political advisory background, brought up the re-election topic,” and claimed, “President Lee is trying to become ‘dictator Lee.’” (조정식 국회의장이 “현직 대통령의 연임 개헌은 국민 선택의 문제”라고 해 논란이 커지자, 여권이 진화에 나섰다. 청와대는 “이재명 대통령도 연임 개헌은 불가능하다고 했다”고 전했고, 더불어민주당 당권 주자 3명도 일제히 “국민 동의를 받기 어려운 얘기”라고 했다. 하지만 야당은 “대통령이 직접 ‘연임은 없다’란 다섯 글자를 왜 말 못 하냐”고 공세를 이어갔다.)

item.title: On the "Sure Defeat" Theory… Kim: "Why Did You Say 'No Comment'?" Jung: "Who Do I Need to Insult to Be Pro-Lee?" (李필패론에… 金 “왜 노코멘트라 했나” 鄭 “누굴 욕해야 친명인가”)
item.description:
On the "Sure Defeat" Theory… Kim: "Why Did You Say 'No Comment'?" Jung: "Who Do I Need to Insult to Be Pro-Lee?" (李필패론에… 金 “왜 노코멘트라 했나” 鄭 “누굴 욕해야 친명인가”)

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, party leadership candidates held their first TV debate on the 29th. Candidates Kim Min-seok, Jung Cheong-rae, and Song Young-gil engaged in heated discussions on issues such as the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung, responsibility for the June 3 local elections, unification with the Fatherland Innovation Party, and the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 당대표 후보들이 29일 첫 TV 토론에 나섰다. 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보는 이재명 대통령의 공소 취소 문제, 6·3 지방선거 책임론, 조국혁신당과의 합당, 검찰 보완수사권 폐지와 관련한 문제에 대해 갑론을박을 벌였다.)

In their opening remarks, Candidate Kim emphasized a "stable party leader," Candidate Jung highlighted a "strong reformist party leader," and Candidate Song underscored a "party leader focused on people's livelihoods." The first point of contention arose over the party's internal discussion process regarding the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. Candidate Kim Min-seok stated, "I advocated for the abolition of the supplementary investigation authority in May. I urged for early action, but I heard it was delayed because Candidate Jung Cheong-rae postponed it." In response, Candidate Jung said, "At the time, General Secretary Kim claimed to have made the request in May, but the bill still hasn't arrived from the government." <<> On the issue of withdrawing the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung, all three candidates agreed that if fabricated charges were revealed, the indictment should be withdrawn. However, they differed on who should be the agent of withdrawal. Candidates Kim and Jung argued that a special counsel investigating fabricated charges could also withdraw the indictment, while Candidate Song countered, "The special counsel should uncover the fabricated charges and prosecute, but once the matter is resolved, it is appropriate for the prosecution, not the special counsel, to withdraw the indictment as a matter of cleaning up their own mess." <<> A debate also ensued over responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections. Candidate Kim said, "In Busan, it was due to a slip of the tongue during the election, and in Pyeongtaek, because the position wasn't well organized, we were practically unable to campaign, weren't we?" He added, "Can these limits on election leadership really be resolved by having the same leader again next year?" In response, Candidate Jung said, "Candidate Kim seems to say that because he has never served as party leader." At this, Candidate Kim brought up Yoo Si-min's recent mention of the 'sure defeat' theory, asking, "Why did you say 'no comment' to such a damning statement? How can you claim to protect the President like that?" Candidate Jung replied, "I hope we don't step on the cross," and added, "Let's not do this thing where insulting someone makes you pro-Lee, and not insulting them makes you something else." However, Candidate Jung refrained from directly addressing Yoo's 'sure defeat' theory until the end. <<> Candidate Kim then alleged that Candidate Jung's camp was inducing votes for three pro-Jung supreme council candidates through so-called "birthday voting" and "odd-even voting," pointing out that this violates party rules and regulations. Candidate Kim stated, "Under the election campaign regulations, the organized act of Candidate Jung gathering with them is precisely factional electioneering, which is defined as illegal." In response, Candidate Jung said, "It's not like I ordered it, is it? When party members act voluntarily, no one can order it or stop it." When Candidate Kim raised the issue again, Candidate Jung retorted, "Candidate Kim was outside the party for 18 years, so he probably doesn't know much about the party's history during the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations. This is something party members have always done voluntarily." <<> The candidates also offered differing solutions regarding recent extreme fluctuations in the KOSPI. Candidate Song argued, "We need emergency measures, such as raising the deposit requirement to 10 to 30 million won, restricting day trading, and activating a stock market stabilization fund." In contrast, Candidate Kim said, "Economic policy messages must be cautious. While emergency measures are necessary, it's better to make decisions after sufficient simulation and careful review by authorities, rather than immediately moving to halt trading." <<> On the issue of unification with the pro-government camp, including the Fatherland Innovation Party, Candidates Jung and Song showed differing views. Candidate Jung argued that, for the presidential election, a one-on-one matchup with the conservative camp should be created, and a single candidate should be fielded through measures like introducing a runoff voting system. Conversely, Candidate Song stated, "If I become party leader, I would postpone unification with the Fatherland Innovation Party for a year. I believe we should first focus on expanding support among the 2030 generation, allow the Fatherland Innovation Party to operate independently by easing the requirements for a negotiation group, and then discuss unification ahead of the general election." <<> Following today's debate, the three candidates are scheduled for two more debates: one on KBS on August 5 and another on SBS on August 12. The Democratic Party's August 17 national convention will hold primary elections across the country for three weeks, starting with the Chungcheong region on August 1, with the final results announced on the 17th. (김 후보는 모두 발언에서 ‘안정적인 당대표’를, 정 후보는 ‘강력한 개혁 당대표’를, 송 후보는 ‘민생을 챙기는 당대표’를 각각 강조했다. 이어 검사의 보완수사권 폐지와 관련된 당내 논의 과정이 첫 번째 쟁점이 됐다. 김민석 후보는 “저는 5월에 보완수사권 폐지를 주장했다. 조기에 처리할 것을 주장했는데, 정청래 후보께서 연기해서 늦춰졌다고 들었다”고 했다. 이에 대해 정 후보는 “당시 김 총리가 5월에 요청을 했다고 하는데 (정부에서) 법안이 지금도 안 와있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Brazil is the Optimal Partner for Civil Aircraft Development and Mineral Supply Chain" (李 “브라질, 민항기 개발·광물 공급망 최적 파트너”)
item.description:
Lee: "Brazil is the Optimal Partner for Civil Aircraft Development and Mineral Supply Chain" (李 “브라질, 민항기 개발·광물 공급망 최적 파트너”)

President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Brazil, stated on the 28th (local time) regarding Korea-Brazil economic cooperation, "We can achieve significant outcomes in three areas: supply chain cooperation in the critical minerals sector, including joint development of next-generation civil aircraft, and K-Beauty, which is enjoying explosive popularity." (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 28일(현지 시각) 한·브라질 경제 협력과 관련해 “차세대 민항기 공동 개발을 포함해 핵심 광물 분야의 공급망 협력, 선풍적 인기를 끌고 있는 K뷰티 등 세 분야에서 큰 성과를 만들 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

In a keynote speech at a business roundtable held in São Paulo, Brazil's economic hub, attended by business leaders from both countries, President Lee said, "If Korea's unparalleled innovative technology and manufacturing capabilities combine with Brazil's abundant resources, we can leap forward as optimal partners leading stable supply chains and future industries together." (이 대통령은 이날 브라질 경제 중심인 상파울루에서 양국 기업인 등이 참석한 가운데 열린 비즈니스 라운드테이블 기조 발언을 통해 “한국의 독보적인 혁신 기술과 제조 역량, 브라질의 풍부한 자원이 힘을 합친다면 안정적인 공급망과 미래 산업을 함께 이끄는 최적의 파트너로 도약할 수 있을 것”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

On the occasion of the event, Korea Aerospace Industries (KAI) and Brazilian aerospace company Embraer signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to strengthen cooperation, including joint development in the civil aircraft and aerospace sectors. Embraer is one of the world's top three civil aircraft manufacturers, alongside Boeing in the U.S. and Airbus in Europe, and is also the manufacturer of the C-390 large transport aircraft being introduced by the Republic of Korea Air Force. (이날 행사를 계기로, 한국항공우주산업(KAI)과 브라질의 항공우주 기업 엠브라에르사(社)는 민항기와 항공우주 분야에서 공동 개발 등 협력을 강화하는 양해각서(MOU)를 체결했다. 엠브라에르사는 미국의 보잉, 유럽의 에어버스와 함께 세계 3대 민항기 업체로, 우리 공군이 도입하는 대형 수송기 C-390 제작사이기도 하다.)

POSCO International signed an MOU with Brazilian company Meteoritic Resources to lay the groundwork for securing a stable rare earth supply chain. Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves, following China. (포스코 인터내셔널은 브라질 메테오릭리소시스와 안정적인 희토류 공급망 확보를 위한 기반을 마련하는 내용의 양해각서(MOU)를 맺었다. 브라질의 희토류 매장량은 중국에 이어 세계 2위다.)

The joint statement released on the same day also included a commitment to complete all procedures for the risk assessment process required for importing Brazilian beef without delay, provided all conditions are met. It also included continued joint efforts to gain market access for Brazilian pork in South Korea. The two countries agreed to appoint 'personnel dedicated to economic cooperation' to oversee the implementation of the joint statement and other economic cooperation efforts, naming Kim Yong-beom, Chief of the Presidential Office Policy Planning, and Geraldo Alckmin, Vice President of Brazil, respectively. (이날 공개된 공동 성명에는 브라질산 쇠고기 수입에 필요한 위험 평가 과정의 모든 절차를, 모든 조건이 충족되는 경우 지체 없이 완료하기로 하는 내용도 포함됐다. 브라질산 돼지고기의 한국 시장 접근에도 공동 노력을 지속하기로 한다는 내용도 담겼다. 양국은 공동 성명 이행 등 경제 협력을 총괄할 ‘경제 협력 전담 인사’를 두기로 하고, 김용범 청와대 정책실장과 아우키민 브라질 부통령을 각각 지명했다.)

On the same day, President Lee visited the São Paulo Metalworkers' Union office, where Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva once worked as a committee chair, and took a commemorative photo at the seat where President Lula had sat. At a meeting with Korean residents in Brazil, President Lee said, "I tend to travel abroad quite a bit since taking office," adding, "Building substantive trust between leaders rapidly improves conditions for local businesses and expatriates." President Lee will then travel to Chile for a meeting with President José Antonio Kast on the 30th. (이 대통령은 이날 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다 시우바 브라질 대통령이 과거 위원장으로 일했던 상파울루 금속노조 사무실을 방문해, 룰라 대통령이 앉았던 자리에서 기념사진을 찍었다. 브라질 동포 간담회에서 이 대통령은 “취임 뒤 해외 순방을 좀 많이 다니는 편”이라며 “정상 간 실질적 신뢰를 쌓으면 현지 기업, 교민 상황이 매우 신속하게 개선된다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 칠레로 이동해 30일 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령과 회담한다.)

item.title: [Episode 33] Inefficient Love ([33화] 효율 없는 사랑)
item.description:
[Episode 33] Inefficient Love ([33화] 효율 없는 사랑)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Irina didn't know. In that moment in Manila, when she was about to melt Evan's brain with high-frequency waves, she didn't know that her phone call had pulled Evan from the hellish noise. The instant the incoming call on her smartphone forcibly cut off the lethal audio output had opened the only window for Evan to hit the brakes. In front of Ronnie Scott's, the jazz bar in Soho, London. (런던 소호 재즈바 로니 스콧 앞.)

The one he'd punched charged again and kicked Evan in the stomach. (에반이 혼신의 힘을 다해 오른쪽 스트레이트를 날렸다. 클린 히트라고 할 순 없었지만, 한 대 제대로 쳤다고 느낀 순간 다른 한 녀석이 등 뒤에서 에반을 붙잡았다. 주먹을 맞은 녀석이 다시 달려와 에반의 복부를 걷어찼다.)

With a grunt, Evan dropped to his knees but still turned his head to look for Irina. His eyes were full of concern, not pain. (윽, 소리와 함께 에반이 무릎을 꿇으면서도 고개를 돌려 이리나를 찾았다. 고통보다 걱정으로 가득한 눈이었다.)

Irina sighed and slowly kicked off her boots, one by one. The moment her bare feet touched the cold pavement, her eyes changed. (이리나는 한숨을 내쉬며 천천히 부츠를 하나씩 벗어 던졌다. 맨발이 차가운 보도블록에 닿는 순간, 눈빛이 변했다.)

Hoo. (후.)

Just as she was about to move, the remaining guy roughly grabbed the back of her neck from behind. (움직이려는 순간 뒤에서 나머지 한 녀석이 그녀의 뒷덜미를 거칠게 낚아챘다.)

"And where do you think you're going?" (“너는 어딜 가려고.”)

Irina's body reacted reflexively. Instead of turning around, she quickly reached her left hand over the guy's right arm that was gripping her neck and grabbed the back of his head. (이리나의 몸이 반사적으로 반응했다. 뒤돌아보는 대신 자신의 목을 잡은 녀석의 오른팔 위로 왼손을 재빠르게 뻗어, 놈의 뒷덜미를 맞잡아 챘다.)

"Ugh!" (“억!”)

Before the startled guy could react, Irina pushed his head forward with force. As his upper body folded, her left foot swept his ankle. (당황한 녀석이 반응하기도 전에, 이리나는 잡은 뒷덜미를 그대로 앞으로 강하게 밀었다. 상체가 접혀지던 순간, 왼발이 놈의 발목을 걷어찼다.)

"Gah!" (“크악!”)

As if witnessing the principle of a lever, the large man's body lifted into the air and crashed to the ground. As soon as he hit the floor, Irina struck the center of his throat precisely with her left fist. (지렛대의 원리를 보는 것처럼, 거구의 사내가 공중에 붕 뜨더니 바닥으로 처박혔다. 이리나는 놈이 바닥에 닿자마자 왼 주먹으로 목 중앙을 정확히 가격했다.)

He was knocked out in three seconds. (3초만에 기절해버렸다.)

Seeing his comrade fly away in an instant, the big guy charged at Irina. Instead of dodging, Irina stepped into the trajectory of his swinging fist, wrapped her arms around his waist, and subdued him with a perfect takedown. (순식간에 동료가 날아가는 것을 본 덩치 큰 녀석이 이리나에게 달려들었다. 이리나는 피하지 않고, 놈이 주먹을 휘두르는 궤적 안으로 파고들어 허리를 감싸 안았다. 그리곤, 완벽한 테이크다운으로 제압했다.)

A scream echoed through the alley. The last guy, seeing the scene, turned and ran without looking back. (비명이 골목을 울렸다. 나머지 한 놈은 그 광경을 보고 뒤도 안 돌아보고 도망쳤다.)

Irina stood up, dusting off her clothes. With a nonchalant expression, she put her hands on her hips and looked down at Evan, who was gasping for breath, covered in blood. (이리나는 옷에 묻은 먼지를 털며 일어났다. 별거 아니라는 표정을 지으며 양팔을 허리에 얹고, 피투성이가 된 채 숨을 헐떡이는 에반을 내려다봤다.)

"You should fight efficiently. You're too slow, and your striking points are all wrong." (“싸움은 효율적으로 해야지. 속도만 느리고 타격점도 엉망이야.”)

Evan, one eye swollen, spat out blood-tinged saliva and asked, (에반은 한쪽 눈이 부어오른 채 피 섞인 침을 뱉으며 물었다.)

"Haah... Irina, you... are you okay? Are you hurt?" (“하아…… 이리나, 너…… 괜찮아? 안 다쳤어?")

There he was, beaten black and blue, unable to even protect himself, worrying about the woman who had just taken down three guys... It was a kind of aura completely different from all the 'pretend-to-be-strong' men Irina had ever seen. (자기 몸 하나 건사하지 못해 흠씬 맞은 주제에, 세 명을 제압한 여자를 걱정하고 있는 모습이라니… 이리나가 평생 보아온 ‘강한 척하는 남자’들과는 전혀 다른 종류의 아우라가 느껴졌다.)

Inefficient, stubborn, and purely uncalculating. (비효율적이고, 미련하고, 계산 없이 순수한.)

"Why didn't you run? You can't even fight." (“왜 도망 안 갔어. 싸울 줄도 모르면서.”)

"Because I had to protect you." (“널 지켜줘야 하니까.”)

Irina was speechless for a moment. She crouched down and wiped Evan's split lip with her thumb. (이리나는 잠시 말을 잃었다. 쭈그리고 앉아 에반의 터진 입술을 엄지로 닦아줬다.)

"...Prostule. Worry about yourself first." (“…… Prostule. 네 걱정부터 해.")

The crushed rose petals on the ground soaked in London's rainwater. (바닥에 짓이겨진 장미 꽃잎이 런던의 빗물에 젖어 들었다.)

The two sat leaning against the alley wall, saying nothing as the rain soaked their clothes. (두 사람은 골목 벽에 등을 기대고 앉아, 옷을 적시는 빗줄기 속에서 아무 말도 하지 않았다.)

Evan's breathing was ragged. Irina's breathing was calm. For thirty seconds, neither of them moved. (에반의 숨소리는 거칠었다. 이리나의 숨소리는 차분했다. 30초 동안 아무도 움직이지 않았다.)

A taxi honked twice as it passed the entrance of the alley. (골목 입구 너머로 택시 한 대가 두 번 경적을 울리고 지나갔다.)

Irina stared at Evan. His lip was split, and the shoulder of his suit jacket was torn. (이리나가 에반을 빤히 쳐다 봤다. 입술이 터졌고, 수트 재킷은 어깨가 찢어져 있었다.)

"Do you want to go out with me?" (“너 나랑 사귈래?”)

Evan's heart trembled before the sound even registered. A raw, genuine laugh burst out. (에반의 가슴이 소리보다 먼저 흔들렸다. 날것 그대로의 웃음이 터져 나왔다.)

Irina's expression was rather serious. (이리나의 표정은 나름 심각했다.)

"Say yes." (“응이라고 해.”)

"Yes." (“응.”)

Evan answered, unable to stop laughing. (에반은 웃음을 멈추지 못한 채 대답했다.)

item.title: 'Leaked Secret' Constitutional Amendment for Presidential Re-election… Will Kim Min-seok's Frontrunner Status Be Shaken? (‘천기누설’ 대통령 연임 개헌론… 김민석 대세론 흔드나)
item.description:
'Leaked Secret' Constitutional Amendment for Presidential Re-election… Will Kim Min-seok's Frontrunner Status Be Shaken? (‘천기누설’ 대통령 연임 개헌론… 김민석 대세론 흔드나)

The race for the next party leader of the Democratic Party through a national convention began on the 28th, kicking off a 20-day schedule. The party leader elected in this convention will support the state affairs operation of the Lee Jae-myung administration in its second to third years, while also overseeing nominations for the next general election and commanding the campaign. Consequently, pro-Lee candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil, along with Jeong Cheong-rae, who is seeking re-election, have entered an uncompromising, all-or-nothing power struggle. (민주당 차기 당대표를 뽑는 전당대회 레이스가 지난 28일부터 20일 간의 일정으로 막이 올랐습니다. 이번 전당대회에서 선출되는 당대표는 이재명 정부 2~3년 차 국정 운영을 뒷받침하면서 차기 총선 공천과 선거 지휘까지 맡게 됩니다. 그래서 친명 진영의 김민석·송영길 후보와 재선을 노리는 정청래 후보가 한 치 양보 없는 사생결단식 당권 전쟁에 돌입했습니다.)

From the first day on the 28th, when the regional tour voting in the Chungcheong region began, the three candidates engaged in fierce psychological warfare. Candidate Jeong appealed to the sentiments of hardline party members, saying, "Voting party members defeat lawmakers." In response, the pro-Lee camp pushed back, accusing him of "dividing lawmakers and party members again." Candidate Jeong also criticized the pro-Lee camp's past opposition to a merger, claiming they would have won the Seoul mayoral election if they had merged with the Fatherland Innovation Party. (세 후보는 충청 지역 순회 투표가 시작된 28일 첫날부터 치열한 신경전을 벌였습니다. 정 후보는 “권리당원이 의원들을 이긴다”며 강성 당원 표심에 호소했습니다. 그러자 친명 진영에선 “또 의원과 당원 갈라치기를 한다”며 반발했습니다. 정 후보는 조국혁신당과 합당했으면 서울시장 선거도 이겼을 것이라며 과거 친명 진영의 합당 반대를 꼬집었습니다.)

In response, the camps of candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil, targeting Candidate Jeong, have repeatedly raised suspicions about a mass enrollment of Shincheonji followers. Candidate Jeong counterattacked, saying, "Raising such suspicions is turning the party into an unconstitutional party," but Candidate Kim rebutted by calling it "foolish sophistry." Candidate Kim's camp also brought up Yoo Si-min's remarks about the 'failure of the Lee Jae-myung government' to raise the issue of anti-Lee judgment. (이에 대해 김민석·송영길 후보 측은 정 후보를 겨냥해 연일 신천지 신도들의 집단 입당 의혹을 제기했습니다. 정 후보는 “의혹 제기가 당을 위헌 정당으로 만들고 있다”고 반격했지만, 김 후보는 “바보 궤변”이라고 재반박했습니다. 김 후보 측은 또 유시민씨의 ‘이재명 정부 실패’ 발언을 걸어 반명 심판론을 제기했습니다.)

To rally pro-Lee party members, Candidate Kim's camp has also launched a '100% voter turnout campaign.' This is based on the judgment that they need to draw votes from general party members, beyond the hardline members who largely support Candidate Jeong, to win. Meanwhile, Candidate Jeong's camp is pushing a 'Lee's bodyguard theory,' stating, "We will protect this president." This signals an intention to embrace not only hardline pro-Chung and pro-Roh members but also pro-Lee members themselves. (김 후보 측은 친명 당원들을 결집하기 위해 ‘투표율 100% 달성 운동’도 시작했습니다. 정 후보 지지층이 많은 강성 당원 이외에 일반 당원들의 투표를 이끌어내야 이길 수 있다는 판단에 따른 것입니다. 반면 정 후보 측은 “우리가 이 대통령을 지킬 것”이라며 ‘李 호위무사론’을 펴고 있습니다. 강성 친청·친문뿐 아니라 친명 당원들까지 끌어안겠다는 뜻입니다.)

Candidate Kim's camp is projecting an air of inevitability, citing leads in various opinion polls. Candidate Kim stated, "I will uphold the livelihoods and practical principles of past Democratic Party presidents." However, Candidate Jeong's camp argues, "The sentiments of hardline party members and grassroots voters are different," claiming, "A reversal trend is imminent, with a Golden Cross approaching." Candidate Jeong said, "I will uphold the will of the late former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan, a pro-Roh and pro-Moon elder." Candidate Song Young-gil stated, "I protected the president not with words but with my whole body; I am a comrade who crossed the line of death with the president," implying that he is the truly pro-Lee candidate. (김 후보 측은 대세론을 펴고 있습니다. 각종 여론조사에서 앞서고 있다는 것입니다. 김 후보는 “역대 민주당 대통령의 민생·실용 원칙을 지키겠다”고 했습니다. 하지만 정 후보 측은 “강성 당원과 밑바닥 표심은 다르다”며 “역전 추세로 골든 크로스가 임박했다”고 주장합니다. 정 후보는 “친노·친문 원로인 고(故) 이해찬 전 총리의 뜻을 받들겠다”고 했습니다. 송영길 후보는 “나는 말이 아니라 온 몸으로 이 대통령을 지켰고 대통령과 사선을 함께 넘은 동지”라고 했습니다. 진짜 친명은 자신이라는 것입니다.)

Amidst this, National Assembly Speaker Jo Jeong-sik's remarks on a 'constitutional amendment for President Lee Jae-myung's re-election' have emerged as a hot variable in the convention. On the 28th, Speaker Jo stated regarding a constitutional amendment allowing the incumbent president's re-election, "It is a matter of public opinion and the people's choice." This was a public mention of the re-election amendment theory that had been circulating within the pro-Lee faction. (이런 와중에 조정식 국회의장의 ‘이재명 대통령 연임 개헌’ 발언이 전당대회의 뜨거운 변수로 떠올랐습니다. 조 의장은 28일 현직 대통령 연임 개헌에 대해 “국민 여론과 국민 선택의 문제”라고 말했습니다. 친명 내부에서 거론되던 이 대통령 연임 개헌론을 공개적으로 언급한 것입니다.)

In response, the opposition party criticized, "This reveals the dark intention to extend President Lee's term," and "The Lee Jae-myung administration is heading toward dictatorship." Legal and academic circles also pointed out, "Under constitutional provisions, a constitutional amendment to extend the incumbent president's term is impossible," and "It violates the spirit of the constitution and is far removed from public opinion." Even within the ruling party, reactions surfaced calling it "an inappropriate claim" and "hard to accept." (그러자 야당에선 “이 대통령 임기 연장의 검은 속내를 드러냈다” “이재명 정부가 독재의 길로 가고 있다”고 비판했습니다. 법조계와 학계에서도 “헌법 규정상 현직 대통령의 임기 연장 개헌은 불가능한 일” “헌법 정신이 위배되고 국민 여론과는 동떨어진 얘기”라고 지적했습니다. 여권 내부에서도 “부적절한 주장” “납득하기 힘든 일”이라는 반응이 나왔습니다.)

Speaker Jo's camp then attempted damage control, stating, "It's not about opening the possibility for the president's re-election." The Presidential Office also expressed regret, saying, "President Lee has already stated his position that re-election is impossible." However, criticism from the opposition, legal circles, and even within the ruling party has not subsided. (그러자 조 의장 측은 “대통령의 연임 가능성을 열어둔 게 아니다”라며 진화에 나섰습니다. 청와대도 “이 대통령이 이미 연임이 불가능하다는 입장을 밝혔다”며 유감을 표시했습니다. 하지만 야당과 법조계는 물론이고 여권 내부에서도 비판 여론은 사그라들지 않았습니다.)

The pro-Lee camp is closely watching whether this 're-election amendment theory' might become a disadvantage for candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil. The sudden raising of the re-election amendment theory by Speaker Jo is seen as having increased negative public opinion towards the pro-Lee candidates and unnecessarily sparked political controversy. (친명 진영에선 이번 ‘연임 개헌론’이 김민석·송영길 후보에게 악재가 되는 것은 아닌지 촉각을 곤두세우고 있습니다. 조 의장이 갑자기 연임 개헌론을 꺼내는 바람에 친명 후보에 대한 부정적 여론이 커지고 불필요한 정치적 논란만 야기했다는 것입니다.)

Pro-Lee figures expressed concerns: "There are murmurs that Yoo Si-min's warning that term extension is impossible was right," "This is a statement that doesn't help the primary at all," and "It might rally pro-Roh and pro-Moon party members towards Jeong Cheong-rae." Conversely, within the pro-Chung and pro-Roh camp, there are claims that "Speaker Jo was voicing the internal concerns of the pro-Lee camp" and "it was a leak of the secretly pursued term extension theory." (친명 인사들은 “임기 연장은 안 된다는 유시민씨 경고 발언이 맞았던 것 아니냐는 말이 나온다” “경선에 전혀 도움이 안 되는 발언” “친노·친문 당원들을 정청래 쪽으로 결집시키는 것 아니냐”고 걱정했습니다. 반면 친청·친문 진영에선 “조 의장이 친명 진영 내부의 목소리를 대변한 것” “비밀리에 추진되던 임기 연장론을 천기누설한 것 아니냐”는 말이 나옵니다.)

Within the ruling party, there are observations that "this term extension theory could become a stumbling block for the 'Kim Min-seok frontrunner theory.'" The camps of Kim and Song have been criticizing Yoo Si-min's remarks against President Lee as anti-Lee agitation and an act of betrayal. However, with Speaker Jo's remarks as a catalyst, public opinion that "Yoo Si-min was right" could conversely grow. There are considerable concerns that the re-election amendment could work against candidates Kim and Song. This is why attention is focused on the results of the regional tour primaries in Chungcheong and Yeongnam, to be announced early next month. (여권에선 “이번 임기 연장론이 ‘김민석 대세론’에 암초로 떠오를 수 있다”는 관측이 나오고 있습니다. 김·송 후보 측은 그동안 이 대통령을 비판한 유시민씨 발언을 반명 선동과 배신 행위로 비판해 왔습니다. 그런데 이번 조 의장 발언을 계기로 “유시민이 옳았다”는 여론이 거꾸로 커질 수 있다는 것입니다. 연임 개헌이 김·송 후보에게 불리하게 작용할 수 있다는 우려가 적지 않습니다. 다음 달 초 발표되는 충청·영남 순회 경선 결과에 시선이 쏠리는 이유입니다.)

This national convention to elect the next party leader will proceed for 20 days until the 17th of next month. As it is a power struggle staking the fate of the 'Myeong' and 'Cheong' factions, fierce psychological warfare has erupted from the start. (차기 당대표를 뽑는 이번 전당대회는 다음 달 17일까지 20일간 진행됩니다. 명·청 간 명운을 건 당권 전쟁인만큼 처음부터 치열한 신경전이 벌어졌습니다.)

Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae posted on social media, '1.6 million voting party members defeat 160 lawmakers,' meaning that even if lawmakers overwhelmingly support a pro-Lee candidate, he will win if the party members support him. Pro-Lee lawmakers criticized this, saying, "He is creating an image as if Candidate Jeong is being oppressed by lawmakers," "Is this another attempt to divide lawmakers and party members?" and "He's trying to pit one lawmaker against ten thousand party members in a fight." (정청래 후보는 SNS에 ‘160만 권리당원이 160명 국회의원을 이긴다’는 글을 올렸습니다. 의원들이 아무리 친명 후보를 지지해도 당원이 자신을 지지하면 이긴다는 뜻입니다. 그러자 친명 의원들은 “마치 정 후보가 의원들에게 탄압받고 있는 듯한 이미지를 연출한다” “또 의원·당원 갈라치기냐” “의원 한 명에 권리당원 만 명씩 패싸움 시킨다”고 비판했습니다.)

Candidate Jeong claimed, "If we had merged with the Fatherland Innovation Party, we would have won the Seoul mayoral election," attacking Candidate Kim Min-seok and some pro-Lee figures for opposing the merger, leading to electoral defeat. Candidate Kim rebutted, calling it "nonsense." He then turned the tables and raised suspicions about the mass entry of Shincheonji followers targeting Candidate Jeong. While Candidate Jeong argued that "such baseless claims should be punished," Candidate Kim retorted that "calling the Shincheonji warning a violation is foolish sophistry." (정 후보는 “조국혁신당과 합당했으면 서울시장 선거도 이겼을 것”이라고 주장했습니다. 김민석 후보와 일부 친명이 합당에 반대해 선거에 졌다고 공격한 겁니다. 김 후보는 “합당 반대 주장은 말도 안 되는 얘기”라고 반박했습니다. 거꾸로 정 후보를 겨냥해 신천지 집단 입당 의혹을 제기했습니다. 정 후보는 “허무맹랑한 주장은 징계해야 한다”고 했지만 김 후보는 “신천지 경고가 해당행위라는 건 바보 궤변”이라고 했습니다.)

The regional tour voting began first in the Chungcheong region. Candidate Jeong's strategy is to seize the initiative early in the tour primary, as Chungcheong is his hometown. His plan is to gain an advantage in the Chungcheong primary, with results announced on the 1st of next month, and then ride the momentum into the Yeongnam region. (지역 순회 투표는 충청에서 제일 먼저 시작됐습니다. 정 후보는 순회 경선 초반에 기선을 잡는다는 전략인데요. 충청이 정 후보 고향이기 때문입니다. 다음 달 1일 결과가 발표되는 충청 경선에서 기선을 잡고 영남으로 여세를 몰아가겠다는 계획입니다.)

There are also talks that Candidate Jeong will push an 'awakened member' movement to rally pro-Roh and pro-Moon-affiliated party members. Borrowing the 'awakened citizen' slogan from the Roh Moo-hyun administration, this means putting forward 'awakened party members.' This seems intended to emphasize that he himself is a successor of the pro-Roh and pro-Moon legacy. (정 후보가 친노·친문 성향 당원을 결집하기 위해 ‘깨당원’ 운동을 추진할 거라는 얘기도 나옵니다. 노무현 정부 때의 ‘깨시민’ 구호를 빌려 ‘깨어 있는 당원’을 앞세운다는 얘기입니다. 스스로 친노·친문의 계승자라는 점을 강조하려는 의도로 보입니다.)

Candidate Jeong's camp is also pushing the 'President Lee's bodyguard theory.' They claim, "We are beyond pro-Lee; we are extreme pro-Lee," "We will definitely push for a special counsel on the manipulated indictment," and "We will protect the president." This strategy aims to embrace not only hardline pro-Chung, pro-Roh, and pro-Moon members but also the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' pro-Lee members. (정 후보 측은 ‘이 대통령 호위무사론’도 펴고 있습니다. 정 후보 측은 “친명을 넘어 극명, 즉 극단적 친명이다” “조작기소 특검은 꼭 추진한다” “대통령은 우리가 지킨다”고 얘기합니다. 친청·친노·친문 성향의 강성 당원뿐 아니라 뉴이재명으로 불리는 친명 당원들도 끌어안겠다는 전략입니다.)

In response, Candidate Kim Min-seok is persistently raising the Shincheonji suspicions and promoting an anti-Lee judgment theory, arguing, "If Jeong Cheong-rae wins, President Lee is in danger. State affairs will be shaken, and the party will split." This strategy aims to heighten a sense of crisis and rally pro-Lee party members. (이에 대응해 김민석 후보는 연일 신천지 의혹을 제기하면서 반명 심판론을 펴고 있습니다. “정청래가 되면 이 대통령이 위험하다. 국정이 흔들리고 당은 쪼개진다”고 얘기합니다. 위기감을 높여 친명 당원을 결집시키려는 전략입니다.)

Candidate Kim has also opened fire on Yoo Si-min's claims that "President Lee is heading down a path of failure," "smells like a rotten fish market," and "should not be subject to the president's control." He questions Candidate Jeong and the pro-Chung camp whether they agree with Yoo's remarks. If they agree or give a 'no comment,' it supposedly proves they are not 'President Lee's bodyguard' or 'pro-Lee,' but clearly 'anti-Lee.' (김 후보는 유시민씨가 “이 대통령이 실패의 길로 가고 있다” “어물전 썩은 내” “대통령의 지배를 받으면 안 된다”고 주장한 것에 대해서도 포문을 열고 있습니다. 정 후보와 친청 진영을 향해 유씨의 발언에 동의하느냐고 반문합니다. 만일 동의하거나 ‘노 코멘트’를 한다면 ‘이 대통령 호위 무사’나 ‘친명’이 아니라 ‘반명’이 확실하다는 것입니다.)

Candidate Kim's camp is also conducting a '100% party member voting campaign.' They calculate that they need to increase turnout among general voting party members, beyond the hardline members who predominantly support Candidate Jeong, to win. The plan is to hold their ground in the early primaries and solidify their lead in the later Honam voting. (김 후보 측은 ‘전당원 100% 투표 운동’도 펼치는데요. 정 후보 지지층이 많은 강성 당원 외에 일반 권리당원 투표율을 높여야 이길 수 있다는 겁니다. 초반 경선에선 선방하고 후반 호남 투표에서 승세를 굳히겠다는 계획입니다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil is promoting a 'true comrade of the president' theory. He argues that while other candidates only pay lip service to being pro-Lee, he has led the charge in saving President Lee, even giving up his own constituency. He emphasizes, "I am the true comrade who crossed the line of death with him." Although he stands alongside Candidate Kim in attacking Candidate Jeong, he stresses that he is not 'Kim Min-seok's assistant' but an 'alternative to Kim Min-seok.' (송영길 후보는 ‘대통령의 진정한 동지론’을 펴고 있습니다. 다른 후보들은 말로만 친명을 외치지만 본인은 지역구도 내어주면서 이 대통령을 살리는 데 앞장섰다는 것입니다. “사선을 함께 넘은 진짜 동지”라고 강조합니다. 정 후보 공격에선 김 후보와 손잡고 선봉에 서 있지만, ‘김민석 도우미’가 아니라 ‘김민석 대체재’라는 점을 강조합니다.)

National Assembly Speaker Jo Jeong-sik's remarks on a 'constitutional amendment for presidential re-election' are showing signs of becoming a significant variable in this primary. Speaker Jo's statement reflects the internal 're-election' voices within the pro-Lee camp. Some pro-Lee figures have reportedly argued in private, "If the people want it, couldn't President Lee be re-elected?" and "If we secure over 200 seats in the next general election, a constitutional amendment is possible." (조정식 국회의장의 ‘대통령 연임 개헌’ 발언은 이번 경선에서 상당한 변수가 될 조짐입니다. 조 의장이 이 발언을 한 것은 친명 내부의 ‘연임’ 목소리를 대변한 측면이 있습니다. 친명 일부 인사들은 사석에서 “국민이 원한다면 이 대통령이 연임할 수 있는 것 아니냐” “다음 총선에서 200석을 넘긴다면 개헌도 가능하다”는 주장을 해왔다고 합니다.)

Speaker Jo's remarks appear to be a multi-purpose card aimed at blocking President Lee's lame-duck status, bypassing the controversy over the withdrawal of the indictment, and emphasizing the need for policy continuity to secure Honam semiconductor investment. It also sends a message that the president's leadership will remain strong, urging all pro-Lee members to unite. (조 의장의 이번 발언은 이 대통령 레임덕을 차단하고, 공소취소 논란을 우회하면서 호남 반도체 투자를 위한 국정 연속성 보장을 강조하는 다목적 카드로 보입니다. 대통령 리더십이 앞으로도 굳건할 테니 친명은 모두 뭉치라는 메시지이기도 합니다.)

However, there is heavy criticism that "a constitutional amendment for the incumbent president's re-election is impossible under constitutional provisions" and "isn't this an authoritarian idea?" The opposition party is launching a wave of attacks against President Lee and Speaker Jo. Legal, academic circles, and progressive groups are no exception. Even within the ruling party, there are many reactions that it "went too far." Among hardline party members, there are murmurs questioning whether Yoo Si-min's warning that 'presidential re-election is impossible' was correct. (하지만 “현직 대통령 연임 개헌은 헌법 규정상 불가능하다” “독재적 발상 아니냐”는 비판이 큽니다. 야당은 이 대통령과 조 의장을 향해 파상 공세를 펴고 있습니다. 법조계와 학계, 진보 단체들도 예외는 아닙니다. 여권 내부에서도 “도가 지나쳤다”는 반응이 많습니다. ‘대통령 연임은 안 된다’는 유시민씨의 경고가 맞았던 것 아니냐는 얘기가 강성 당원들 사이에서 나옵니다.)

This has a high potential to backfire on the pro-Lee camp. This is why Speaker Jo's camp belatedly stepped in to manage the fallout, claiming they were "merely stating a principle." Candidate Kim Min-seok's camp worries that "with the approval rating gap not being large, this could become a significant disadvantage." Some say the "unexpected re-election amendment remarks have thrown cold water on Candidate Kim's frontrunner status." Candidate Jeong's camp appears to be managing its public expression. Candidate Jeong commented, "I think he was set up by reporters. I'll tell Speaker Jo to be careful." (이는 친명 진영에 역풍을 부를 가능성이 큽니다. 조 의장 측이 뒤늦게 “원칙론을 밝힌 것일 뿐”이라며 수습에 나선 것도 이 때문입니다. 김민석 후보 진영에선 “지지율 격차가 크지 않은 상황에서 적잖은 악재가 될 수 있다”고 우려합니다. 일부는 “뜬금없는 연임 개헌 발언으로 김 후보 대세론을 찬물을 끼얹었다”고도 합니다. 정 후보 측은 표정 관리에 나선 듯한 분위기입니다. 정 후보는 “기자들에게 낚인 것 같다. 조 의장에게 잘하라고 하겠다”고 했습니다.)

It is difficult to predict the current landscape easily. However, there are reports that Candidate Kim Min-seok held a slight lead in the preliminary primary. The pro-Lee camp maintains that the Kim Min-seok frontrunner theory is valid. Pro-Lee figures stated, "Candidate Kim's slight advantage will likely continue." However, on the ground, Candidate Jeong's pursuit is reportedly formidable. Candidate Jeong's camp claims, "Trends are important, and we are catching up," asserting that "a Golden Cross will occur soon." Candidate Song's camp predicts a "late-stage reversal." (현재 판세는 쉽게 예단하기 힘듭니다. 다만 예비경선에선 김민석 후보가 미세하게 앞섰다는 얘기가 나옵니다. 친명은 김민석 대세론이 유효하다고 얘기합니다. 친명 인사들은 “김 후보의 소폭 우세 국면이 계속 이어질 것”이라고 했습니다. 하지만 현장에선 정 후보의 추격세가 만만치 않다고 합니다. 정 후보 측은 “추세가 중요한데 따라잡고 있다”며 “조만간 골든 크로스가 일어날 것”이라고 주장합니다. 송 후보 측은 “막판 뒤집기가 일어날 것”이라고 합니다.)

There are three variables. First is the initial flow of the tour primary. If Candidate Jeong takes an early lead, it could shake the Kim Min-seok frontrunner theory. Second is the voter turnout. Higher turnout generally leads to greater participation from general party members, which favors Candidate Kim. Third are unexpected variables like the constitutional amendment theory. While the Presidential Office and the pro-Lee camp are trying to quickly quell the fallout from the amendment remarks, if the controversy persists, it could create an unfavorable situation for candidates Kim and Song. (변수는 세 가지입니다. 첫째 순회 경선 초반 흐름입니다. 만약 정 후보가 초반에 앞서면 김민석 대세론이 흔들릴 수 있습니다. 둘째는 투표율입니다. 투표율이 높을수록 일반 당원 참여가 늘기 때문에 김 후보에 유리합니다. 셋째는 개헌론과 같은 돌발 변수입니다. 청와대와 친명 진영은 개헌 발언 파문 조기 진화에 나섰는데, 논란이 계속 이어지면 김·송 후보에겐 불리한 상황이 올 수 있습니다.)

There are also rumors that Yoo Si-min might appear on YouTube and make another explosive statement. The direction of the Shincheonji investigation is also unpredictable. Whether it will be the Kim Min-seok frontrunner theory, a Jeong Cheong-rae Golden Cross, or a late reversal by Song Young-gil will become clearer with the results of the tour primary in early August. (유시민씨가 유튜브에 출연해 또 폭탄 발언을 할 수 있다는 소문도 있습니다. 신천지 수사가 어디로 튈 지도 알 수 없습니다. 김민석 대세론이냐, 정청래 골든 크로스냐, 송영길의 막판 뒤집기냐는 8월 초 순회 경선 결과를 보면 윤곽이 드러날 것입니다.)

item.title: President Lee arrives in Santiago, Chile... Summit with President Kast on the 30th (李대통령, 칠레 산티아고 도착...30일 카스트 대통령과 정상회담)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently touring the United States and South America, arrived in Santiago, the capital of Chile, his second stop, on the 29th (local time) after completing his state visit to Brazil, beginning a two-day official visit schedule. (미국과 남미를 순방 중인 이재명 대통령이 29일(현지 시각) 브라질 국빈 방문 일정을 마치고 두 번째 방문지인 칠레의 수도 산티아고에 도착해 1박 2일 동안의 공식 방문 일정을 시작했다.)

The President will hold a dinner meeting with local compatriots on the afternoon of the same day. On the 30th, he is scheduled to hold a summit with Chilean President José Antonio Kast, who took office in March. Following an official welcome ceremony and gift exchange at the Chilean Presidential Palace, the summit will take place, followed by a memorandum of understanding (MOU) signing ceremony, joint press conference, and official lunch. (이 대통령은 이날 오후 현지 동포들과 만찬 간담회를 갖는다. 30일에는 지난 3월 취임한 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령과 정상회담을 가질 예정이다. 칠레 대통령궁에서 공식 환영식과 선물 교환식에 이어 정상회담을 갖고, 양해각서(MOU) 서명식과 공동 언론 발표, 공식 오찬이 이어진다.)

Regarding the main agenda of this summit, Cheong Wa Dae National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said in a briefing on the 22nd of last month, "We will discuss the 'modernization of the FTA' with Chile, our first FTA partner." This means that, as the Korea-Chile FTA, which took effect in 2004, is now over 20 years old, discussions will be held on adjusting the FTA to fit current circumstances. A Cheong Wa Dae official stated, "As both countries have areas they wish to further open, there are elements to modernize in line with the latest FTA trends, and negotiations are underway." (이번 정상회담의 주요 의제와 관련해, 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 지난달 22일 브리핑에서 “우리의 첫 FTA 체결국인 칠레와 ‘FTA 현대화’를 논의하게 된다”고 했다. 지난 2004년 발효된 한·칠레 FTA가 20년이 넘은 만큼, FTA를 최근 상황에 맞게 조정하는 작업을 논의하게 된다는 얘기다. 청와대 측은 “양국이 서로 추가 개방을 원하는 것이 있기 때문에 최신 FTA 트렌드에 맞게 현대화할 요소가 있고 협상을 진행 중”이라고 했다.)

Discussions are also expected regarding key mineral supply chains with Chile, a resource-rich country. Chile holds the world's largest reserves of copper and lithium. (자원 부국인 칠레와 핵심 광물 공급망 관련 논의도 이뤄질 전망이다. 칠레는 구리와 리튬 매장량이 세계 1위다.)

Before the summit, President Lee will lay a wreath at the statue of Bernardo O'Higgins, Chile's founding hero. O'Higgins is a figure revered as the father of the nation by the Chilean people for leading the country's war of independence to victory in the early 19th century. (이 대통령은 정상회담 전, 칠레의 건국 영웅 베르나르도 오이긴스 동상에 헌화한다. 오이긴스는 19세기 초 칠레의 독립 전쟁을 승리로 이끌어 칠레 국민들에게 국부로 추앙받는 인물이다.)

Following the summit, the President will attend the "Korea-Chile Business Roundtable" event with business leaders from both countries, and is scheduled to depart on the evening of the 31st for Buenos Aires, Argentina, the final stop of his South American tour. (이 대통령은 정상회담 뒤 양국 기업인이 참석하는 ‘한·칠레 비즈니스 라운드테이블’ 행사에도 참석한 뒤 31일 저녁 남미 순방의 마지막 방문국인 아르헨티나 부에노스아이레스로 이동할 예정이다.)
