item.title: ‘If Illegal Investigation Occurs, Court May Dismiss Indictment’ — Sneaked into Bill Abolishing Supplementary Investigations (‘위법 수사땐 법원이 공소 기각’ 보완수사 폐지법에 끼워 넣어)
item.description:
‘If Illegal Investigation Occurs, Court May Dismiss Indictment’ — Sneaked into Bill Abolishing Supplementary Investigations (‘위법 수사땐 법원이 공소 기각’ 보완수사 폐지법에 끼워 넣어)

It was confirmed on the 29th that the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) belatedly added ‘grounds for court dismissal of indictment’ to a revision of the Criminal Procedure Act aimed at completely abolishing the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority. During a late-night closed-door bill review the previous day, the Ministry of Justice and the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office expressed opposition, but the DPK pushed it through without agreement from the opposition party. The People Power Party (PPP) called it “President Lee Jae-myung’s trial-erasure law,” saying, “When it became difficult to introduce a special counsel for indictment cancellation, they created a detour to allow the court to dismiss the indictment.” However, the DPK held a plenary session of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee on that day and forcibly passed the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act. <<> The DPK and other pro-government lawmakers reportedly passed the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act during a late-night subcommittee meeting on the 28th, with PPP lawmakers absent, by adding provisions expanding the grounds for dismissal of indictment, which had not been previously discussed. Dismissal of indictment is a procedure that terminates a case without ruling on guilt or innocence when there is a serious defect in the filing of the indictment. Under the current Criminal Procedure Act, dismissal is allowed only when the indictment process violates legal regulations or when it is determined that the court lacks jurisdiction over the defendant. <<> However, the revision adds two new grounds: ‘when an indictment is filed based on a serious illegal investigation’ and ‘when an indictment is filed through a significant deviation from prosecutorial discretion.’ This provides legal grounds for a defendant to argue that “the prosecution conducted a targeted or illegal investigation” and, if the court accepts it, to halt the trial. Despite the Ministry of Justice opposing the revision, citing “concerns over serious side effects,” the DPK forced the amendment through. <<> The DPK also forcibly passed the ‘Fast-Track Deadline Reduction Act’ on the same day. This aims to shorten the current fast-track review period, which takes up to 330 days (180 days in standing committees, 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and 60 days in the plenary session), to 60 days in standing committees, 30 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and submission to the first plenary session after referral. <<> ◇If Indictment Cannot Be Cancelled via Special Counsel, Court Dismisses It… A Dual Device to ‘Save Lee’ <<> Regarding the DPK’s addition of grounds for dismissal of indictment to the Criminal Procedure Act revision, opposition party and legal circles pointed out, “The DPK, after attempting to cancel the indictment in the president’s case by pushing a ‘special counsel for manipulated indictments,’ found the circumstances unfavorable, so they are now creating a ‘detour’ to halt trials through court dismissal of indictment.” <<> The current Article 327 of the Criminal Procedure Act allows dismissal of indictment only under six conditions, such as ‘when there is no jurisdiction over the defendant,’ ‘when the indictment procedure violates legal regulations and is invalid,’ and ‘when a complaint is withdrawn.’ A lawyer and former chief judge said, “The law’s intent is to restrict conditions to a minimum, as it is a serious decision to halt the verdict itself without judging guilt or innocence.” <<> However, the revision adds two new grounds: ‘serious illegal investigation’ and ‘deviation from discretion.’ Additionally, it includes a provision on the prosecutor’s duty of objectivity, stating, “Prosecutors must maintain objectivity and neutrality in the process of filing and maintaining indictments and take necessary measures for the interests of suspects and defendants.” <<> Legal circles expressed concerns that “with the strengthened prosecutor duty clause and the addition of vague and subjective grounds like ‘illegal investigation’ or ‘deviation from prosecutorial authority,’ the court might accept a defendant’s arbitrary claims and terminate the trial.” PPP Judiciary Committee lawmaker Joo Jin-woo said on Facebook that day, “This is an attempt to erase the criminal trial of the president through legislative power.” Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also said, “In cases like the North Korean remittance case, where (President Lee’s) innocence seems impossible and indictment cancellation is difficult, they aim to pressure the court to issue a dismissal of indictment verdict. Indictment cancellation is Plan A, constitutional amendment for re-election is Plan B, and dismissal of indictment is Plan C.” <<> During the full committee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day, PPP lawmakers opposed the complete abolition of supplementary investigation authority, arguing, “We need sufficient discussion to protect victims and prevent investigative gaps,” but Committee Chairman Seo Young-kyo of the DKP pushed for a vote. The DKP plans to submit the revision to the National Assembly’s plenary session on the 30th. If the PPP conducts a filibuster, they intend to forcibly terminate it after 24 hours and process it on the 31st. This means processing it in a ‘cramming’ style less than a week after adopting the abolition of supplementary investigation as party policy at a general meeting of lawmakers on the 24th. <<> The DKP stated, “Instead of ‘completely abolishing’ the prosecution’s investigation authority (in the Criminal Procedure Act), we have sufficiently prepared supplementary measures, such as enhancing the effectiveness of requests for supplementary investigations.” However, many legal professionals expressed doubts about the effectiveness of the right to request supplementary investigations, worrying, “The problems of case burial and investigative delays will become more serious.” <<> The revision adds a prosecutor’s ‘management responsibility’ to track the implementation of supplementary investigations, such as maintaining the case number in the Criminal Justice Information System (KICS) when a prosecutor requests one. A chief prosecutor in the Seoul metropolitan area said, “They’ve stripped us of investigative authority, leaving us unable to do anything, but now they only want to hold us accountable for cases where we’ve requested supplementary investigations.” <<> A new ‘fact-finding’ procedure for prosecutors has also been created, allowing them to interview suspects, case-related individuals, experts, and judicial police officers, or receive materials, as needed before deciding on indictment filing or maintenance, or requesting reinvestigation. However, statements and materials obtained through fact-finding are not recognized as evidence, leading to criticism that “it holds little effectiveness and could cause confusion in trials regarding evidentiary capacity.” <<> The initial revision proposed by the DKP granted police the authority to arrest and detain suspects for 48 hours without prosecutor oversight. However, after repeated concerns about ‘excessive investigations’ by the police, the relevant provisions were removed from the final version. <<> Legal circles and the opposition party unanimously criticized the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority. Acting Prosecutor General Gu Ja-hyun issued a statement that day, saying, “If the prosecutor’s effective functions of checking, supplementing, and correcting disappear, the truth will be concealed, and the Republic of Korea’s criminal justice system will collapse. The victims will be the people, who need the state’s protection more than anyone else.” (더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 골자로 하는 형사소송법 개정안에 뒤늦게 ‘법원의 공소기각 사유’를 추가한 것으로 29일 확인됐다. 전날 밤 비공개 법안 심사 과정에서 법무부와 대검찰청이 반대 의견을 냈지만 야당과 합의 없이 밀어붙인 것이다. 국민의힘은 “이재명 대통령의 재판 지우기법”이라며 “공소취소 특검 도입이 어려워진다 싶으니까 이번에는 법원이 공소를 기각하도록 우회로를 만든 것”이라고 했다. 하지만 민주당은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의를 열고 형소법 개정안을 강행 처리했다.)

item.title: Amid Backlash from Ruling Bloc… New US Ambassador to Korea Assumes Post (여권 일부 반발 속에… 부임하는 주한美대사)
item.description:
Amid Backlash from Ruling Bloc… New US Ambassador to Korea Assumes Post (여권 일부 반발 속에… 부임하는 주한美대사)

Michelle Steel (Korean name: Park Eun-ju), the first female Korean-American US ambassador to South Korea, arrives in Seoul on the 30th. Ambassador Steel is the first ambassador to South Korea under the second Trump administration, filling a vacancy that lasted about a year and a half since former Ambassador Philip Goldberg departed. During that time, the US Embassy in Seoul operated under a chargé d'affaires system with Joseph Yun, Kevin Kim, and James Heller. (한국계 첫 여성 주한미국대사인 미셸 스틸(한국명 박은주)이 30일 서울에 부임한다. 스틸 대사는 트럼프 2기의 첫 주한대사로, 필립 골드버그 전 대사 이임 후 약 1년 반 만에 주한미대사 공백 사태가 해소됐다. 그동안 주한미대사관은 조셉 윤, 케빈 김, 제임스 헬러 대사대리 체제로 운영돼 왔다.)

Ambassador Steel, the daughter of a displaced person and the second Korean-American ambassador to South Korea born in Seoul in 1955, is not receiving a ‘blessing’ from the ruling bloc, including the Democratic Party. This contrasts sharply with the atmosphere when Sung Kim was appointed as the first Korean-American US ambassador to South Korea. (스틸 대사는 실향민의 딸로 1955년 서울에서 태어난 두번째 한국계 주한미대사지만, 민주당을 비롯한 여권의 ‘블레싱(축복)’을 받지 못하고 있다. 성 김이 한국계 미국인으로는 최초로 주한미대사에 임명됐을 때와는 사뭇 다른 분위기다.)

The left-wing camp is opposing Steel, citing her past hardline stance on North Korea and China issues and her tendency to engage primarily with conservative figures in South Korea. (좌파 진영은 스틸 대사가 그동안 북한, 중국 문제에 대해 강경한 입장을 보였으며 주로 한국의 보수적인 인사들과 교류해왔다며 반발하고 있다.)

In response, the US side has reinforced its security team and requested protection from South Korean police, preparing for possible protests at Incheon Airport where Ambassador Steel will arrive. The embassy is also cautious about issuing a statement regarding Steel's arrival. (이에 따라 미국 측은 스틸 대사가 입국하는 인천공항에 반대 시위가 있을 가능성 등에 대비, 자체 경호팀을 보강하고 한국 경찰에도 경호 요청을 했다. 대사관측도 스틸 대사의 입국 성명 발표 등에 대해 신중한 모습을 보이고 있다.)

South Korea's left-wing camp has been continuously campaigning against Steel since she was nominated as ambassador in April. Shortly after the White House's announcement, left-wing groups held a rally in front of the US Embassy in Seoul and issued a joint statement titled "Withdraw the Nomination of Michelle Steel as US Ambassador to South Korea, Who Turns the Korean Peninsula into a Battlefield of Confrontation and Leads Trump's Exploitative Policies." They claimed over 400 organizations participated. During a May ‘Candlelight March for Ending the Insurrection’ rally, there were claims that "Michelle Steel is not the US ambassador to South Korea but an ambassador to the far-right in South Korea, coming to attack the Lee Jae-myung government and command domestic far-right forces." (한국의 좌파 진영은 스틸이 지난 4월 대사에 지명됐을 때 부터 지속적으로 반대 운동을 벌이고 있다. 좌파단체들은 백악관 발표 직후 주한미대사관 앞에서 집회를 갖고 “한반도를 대결의 전장으로 만들고 트럼프의 수탈 정책 선봉에 선 미셸 스틸의 주한미대사 지명 철회하라”는 제목의 공동 성명을 발표했다. 400여 단체가 이에 동참했다고 밝히기도 했다. 지난 5월 ‘내란청산 촛불 대행진’ 집회에서는 “미셸 스틸은 주한미대사가 아니라 주한극우대사로 이재명 정부를 공격하며 국내 극우세력을 지휘하러 오는 자”라는 주장이 나오기도 했다.)

◇First Female Korean-American US Ambassador to South Korea… Ruling Bloc Labels Her “Far-Right Hardliner” (◇한국계 여성 첫 주한 美 대사… 여권선 “극우·강경파” 날세워)

Song Young-gil, a former leader of the Democratic Party of Korea and a candidate for the next foreign minister, is at the forefront of this negative stance. Last month, even after Steel was confirmed by the US Senate, Song mentioned former Deputy Secretary of State Steve Biegun, who was involved in US-North Korea summit talks, saying, "It is a great pity that someone like him didn't come as the US ambassador to South Korea." He also added, "Going forward, rather than repeating controversies after appointment, we need to exert influence to recommend trusted figures in advance through bilateral consultation." (더불어민주당 대표를 지내고, 차기 외교부 장관으로도 거론되는 송영길 의원은 이같은 부정적인 입장의 선두에 서 있다. 송 의원은 지난달 스틸 대사가 미 상원에서 인준됐음에도 미북 정상회담에 관여했던 스티브 비건 전 국무부 부장관을 거론하며 “이런 분이 주한 미국대사로 왔더라면 하는 아쉬움이 크다”고 했다. 또, “앞으로는 (주한미대사) 임명 이후 논란을 반복하기보다 사전에 양국이 신뢰할 수 있는 인물을 추천할 수 있는 영향력을 발휘할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

The sentiment of displeasure toward Steel extends beyond the Democratic Party to the Rebuilding Korea Party, which is being considered for a possible merger with the Democratic Party. Kim Jun-hyung, floor leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, last year mentioned Steel as one of the ‘five anti-Korea figures’ during the personnel hearing for Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul. In a media interview, he suggested caution regarding the agrément, claiming she was linked to far-right forces in South Korea. (스틸 대사를 탐탁지 않게 여기는 분위기는 민주당뿐만 아니라 합당 가능성이 거론되는 조국혁신당에도 퍼져 있다. 조국혁신당의 김준형 원내대표는 지난해 조현 외교부 장관 인사 청문회에서 스틸을 ‘반한(反韓) 5적’ 중 한 명으로 거론했다. 또 언론 인터뷰에서 그가 한국의 극우 세력과 연관돼 있다며 아그레망 신중론을 폈다.)

It is known that the White House and US State Department are closely monitoring these moves by the ruling bloc and have conveyed concerns to the South Korean government. They worry that moves to reject an ambassador appointed by President Trump with full powers could negatively impact the US-South Korea alliance. (미 백악관과 국무부는 여권의 이같은 움직임을 예의주시하며 우리 정부에 우려를 전한 것으로 알려졌다. 트럼프 대통령이 임명한 특명전권대사 거부 움직임이 한미관계에 부정적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 것이다.)

The US side views that Steel merely holds principled stances that North Korea and China should not threaten neighboring countries and should respect the human rights of North Korean residents, while South Korea's left-wing camp is labeling her ‘far-right’ and ‘hardline.’ In May 2022, as a US House Representative, Steel co-signed a letter with Rep. Young Kim to the Secretaries of State and Defense following the launch of the Yoon Suk Yeol government, pointing out that "Kim Jong-un has no interest in a declaration to end the war and is focused on improving the ability to fire nuclear warheads or short-range conventional warheads at military bases in South Korea, Japan, and the US." The letter also stated that "cooperating with the South Korean administration to strengthen US deterrence in Northeast Asia is critical to prevent further escalation of tensions by North Korea." Additionally, it urged the Chinese government to stop forced repatriation of North Korean defectors, noting that "North Korea and the Chinese Communist Party are actively tracking defectors." A source close to Steel said, "Upon taking office, Ambassador Steel will seek to clear up misunderstandings about her and express her intention to further strengthen the US-South Korea relationship at this critical time." (미국 측은 스틸 대사가 북한과 중국이 주변국을 위협하지 말아야 하며 북한 주민의 인권을 중시해야 한다는 원칙적인 입장을 갖고 있을 뿐인데, 한국의 좌파 진영이 ‘극우’ ‘강경파’ 딱지를 붙이고 있다고 보고 있다. 스틸 대사는 연방하원의원 시절인 2022년 5월 윤석열 정부 출범에 맞춰 영 김 의원과 함께 국무·국방 장관에게 보낸 서한에서 “김정은이 종전 선언에 관심이 없으며 한국과 일본, 미국 군사 기지에 대해 핵탄두 또는 단거리 재래식 탄두를 발사할 수 있는 능력 향상에 집중하고 있다”고 지적했다. 또 “북한의 추가적인 긴장 고조를 막기 위해 동북아에서 미국의 억지력을 강화하는 데 한국 행정부와 협력하는 것이 매우 중요하다”고 했다. 이 서한은 또 “북한과 중국 공산당이 탈북민을 적극적으로 추적하고 있다”며 중국 정부의 탈북민 강제 북송 중단을 촉구했다. 스틸 대사와 가까운 관계자는 “스틸 대사가 부임하면 자신에 대한 오해를 풀고, 중요한 시기에 한미 관계를 더욱 강하게 만들겠다는 입장을 밝힐 것”이라고 했다.)

Diplomatic circles are concerned about a repeat of the conflict seen during the tenure of former US Ambassador to South Korea Harry Harris. At that time, the left-wing camp attacked Harris, who is of Japanese descent, over his North Korea policy and even likened his mustache to that of Japanese colonial-era governors-general of Korea. Harris also reacted emotionally on some issues, leading to a strained relationship between the two sides. (외교가에서는 과거 해리 해리스 전 주한 미국 대사 때와 같은 갈등이 재연되지 않을까 우려하고 있다. 당시 좌파 진영은 일본계인 해리스 대사의 대북 정책을 공격하며 그의 콧수염이 일제 시대 조선 총독을 연상시킨다고도 했다. 해리스 대사 역시 일부 사안에서 감정적으로 대응하면서 양측의 관계는 원만하지 못했다.)

Ambassador Steel is a former US House Representative, first elected in 2020 for California's 48th congressional district and re-elected in 2022. In Congress, she consistently voiced support for North Korean human rights, containing China, and the US-South Korea alliance. Her husband, Sean Steel, is a prominent figure who served as the California state representative for the Republican National Committee (RNC) and played a key role in organizational expansion and fundraising for Trump's presidential campaign. He is frequently invited to major White House events hosted by President Trump and is known to have influenced Steel's appointment as ambassador. Trump described Steel as a "‘America First patriot’ whose parents bravely escaped communism," and she is also seen as a politician who can immediately call the White House in times of crisis. (스틸 대사는 2020년 캘리포니아주 제48선거구에서 연방하원의원에 당선된 데 이어 2022년 재선에 성공한 연방하원의원 출신이다. 연방의회에서는 북한 인권, 중국 견제, 한미동맹에 대해 꾸준히 목소리를 내왔다. 남편 숀 스틸은 공화당 전국위원회(RNC) 캘리포니아주 대표를 지낸 유력 인사로 트럼프 대통령의 대선 캠프에서 조직 확장, 정치자금 모금에서 핵심적인 역할을 했다. 트럼프 대통령이 백악관에서 개최하는 주요 행사에 자주 초청하는 인물로 스틸이 대사가 되는데 영향을 미친 것으로 알려졌다. 트럼프는 스틸 대사에 대해 “(부모가) 공산주의를 피해 용감하게 탈출한 ‘미국 우선주의 애국자”라고 했는데, 유사시 즉각 백악관에 전화해 통화할 수 있는 정치인이라는 평가도 나온다.)

A former high-ranking foreign ministry official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said, "Currently, many issues are piling up between South Korea and the US, such as the Coupang problem, the transfer of wartime operational control, revision of the nuclear agreement, and trade and tariff negotiations." He added, "Ambassador Steel should actively work to clear up misunderstandings about herself, and the ruling bloc should also refrain from excessive ideological attacks." (익명을 요구한 전직 외교부 고위 관계자는 “지금은 한미 양국 간에 쿠팡 문제, 전시작전통제권 전환, 원자력 협정 개정, 통상·관세 협상 등 현안이 산적해 있는 상황”이라며 “스틸 대사가 적극적으로 자신에 대한 오해를 해소하려는 노력을 기울이고, 여권도 과도한 이념 공세를 자제해야 한다”고 했다.)
